m300111.――ああッ！？\nほら、あそこじゃ！\nピカピカ光っておるじゃろう！？: —Ah! Look, over there! It's shining brightly, isn't it!?
m300111.――ウぅッ……グ、はぁ……ハァ……。\nそんな……バカ、な……。\n竜人族が……: ――Ugh… ha… ha… This… how foolish… the draconians losing to humans…?
m300111.……あれ、貴方たち物質界の人間……ね……？\nここで何をしているの？: …Huh, you folks from the Material World…? What are you doing here?
m300111.……こうしてはいられません！\nもっともっと私達も強くならないと、\n王子を守れ: …We can't just stand around like this! We have to get a lot stronger if we're ever going to protect the Prince!
m300111.……そう、カ……ありがとう……人間達よ。\n……サラバだ……帝国の勇士達よ。: …Yes… thank you… humans. …Farewell… brave warriors of the Empire.
m300111.……なんじゃ？ 襲ってくるかと思ったが、\nピカピカは、帰っていった様じゃな。\: …What's that? I thought they'd attack, but the shiny ones seem to have gone back. Wasted my worry. Let's head back—
m300111.……他ノ竜人達は……、\nこれまで通り、帝国ノ戦士として……、\n重用してほしい: …I want the other draconians to keep serving as Imperial soldiers… please, count on me.
m300111.……好きにすればいいよ。全部を相手にするのは\n無理だけど、出来るだけわたしが倒: …Do whatever you want. I can't take them all on, but I'll try to beat it for you. You protect yourselves.
m300111.……断る。\n……貴様は既に帝国の戦士ではない。\nさっさと失せろ。: …I refuse. …You are no longer an Imperial soldier. Leave at once.
m300111.……王子。\nあなたには皆を率いることのできる素質と\nそして困難にも負けない勇:
...Prince.
You have the quality to lead everyone
and the courage that won't bow to hardship.
m300111.……逃げられたようですね。\nそれにしても、手強い相手でした。: …It looks like they got away. Still, they were a tough opponent.
m300111.…さて、わしは酒呑童子の元へ行くことにするか。\n人間どもよ！ 肩慣らしには丁度: …Well then, I'll head back to Shuten-Dōji. Humans! That was a good warm-up. Next time, we'll meet for real!
m300111.あ……行ってしまいました。\nいったい何者だったのでしょうか？: Ah… she's gone. Who on earth was that?
m300111.あ、あの……本当に王子に内緒で\n魔界に来てしまってよかったのでしょうか……？: Um… are we really okay having come here without the Prince knowing?
m300111.あ、あの～…、メトゥスさん…？\n王子たち行っちゃうよ…？: Um, uh… Metus-san…? The Prince and the others are leaving…?
m300111.あっ！ 王子、向かってきます！\n戦いは避けられそうにありません。: Ah! Prince, they're coming! There's no way to avoid the battle.
m300111.あての名は鬼刃姫。\n次に会う時は、必ず勝ってみせる……。: My name is Kibahime. The next time we meet, I'll be sure to win…
m300111.あなたが立派な王となるまで、\n私達はずっと御側にいますから！:
Until you become a fine king,
we'll always stand by your side!
m300111.あの……エルンさん。\n大天使長はなぜ、先程の天使と共に\n私達に襲いかかってこ: Um… Erun-san. Why didn't the Archangel attack us together with that angel earlier?
m300111.あのクロノデーモンと名乗った魔物の来襲以来、\n王子の顔つきは以前よりもずっと\:
Since that monster calling itself the Chrono Demon attacked,
your expression, Prince, has become much more steadfast than before.
m300111.あの様子ですと、\nいずれまた襲ってくる可能性が高いですね……。: From the looks of it, they're likely to strike again sometime later…
m300111.あら、ごめんなさいね。\n少しぼーっとしちゃってたわ。\nそれじゃ、私たちもダー: Ah, sorry. I was spacing out a bit. Well then, let's head home together with Darling!
m300111.あれは……鬼刃衆！？\nまさか、待ち伏せしていたというのですか？:
That... the Oni Blade Squad!?
Could they have been lying in ambush?
m300111.いい加減、王子に頼りすぎるのも悪いじゃろう。\n少しは魔界のことをわしらで調査し: Honestly, relying on the Prince all the time isn't good. We should investigate the Demon Realm ourselves and get some useful intel.
m300111.いよいよ私達だけで魔界に来ちゃいましたね！: At last, it's just us in the Demon Realm!
m300111.お願いします。\n私も過去の文献を見てみる事にします。\nでは王子、一度帰還しま: Please. I'll also dig through the old records. Well then, Prince, let's head back. Good work.
m300111.かつて竜人達が棲んでいた地に還ル……。\nそこで、我らは再ビ偉大なる種の誇りを取: We'll return to the lands where dragonfolk once dwelled… there, we'll reclaim the pride of our great race.
m300111.くそ……なぜだ。なぜ帝国に反逆する！？\n白の帝国は、貴様ら竜人を誇りある戦士と:
Damn… why? Why rebel against the Empire!?
The White Empire gave you dragon warriors honor, granting you status and rights equal to humans.
m300111.この世にある土や水、火、風なんかの\n自然物にはそれぞれ小さなエネルギーが\n宿: You know how every natural thing—soil, water, fire, wind—has a little bit of energy inside it, right?
m300111.この国を守る為には、自らが強くならねばと\nこうして王子が我らに教えを請うている:
To protect this country, we must become stronger ourselves,
and that's why the Prince is seeking guidance from us.
We must do our utmost to answer him!
m300111.これで、魔物は全部倒せたみてぇだな……。: Looks like we've taken out all the monsters…
m300111.これは……聞いていた以上の数ですね……。\n何故これほどまでに鬼が出現しているの: This… is more than I heard… Why are so many demons appearing?
m300111.これほどまでに力の差があるとはね……。\n今一度、鬼刃衆を鍛え直さなくては、\n: To think there's such a gap in power… If we don't retrain the Oni Blade Squad, I don't think we can defeat my father.
m300111.さすがにゴブリン達を見逃すわけにはいきませんね。\n王子、ここで討伐しましょう！: We can't just let those goblins get away. Prince, let's take them down here!
m300111.さすがは酒呑童子の四天王\nといったところですね……。: As expected of Shuten-Dōji's Four Heavenly King…
m300111.さて、私も帰る事にしましょう。: Well then, I shall be heading back as well.
m300111.すごいです、王子！\nまさかこの訓練を乗り切るとは……。:
Incredible, Prince!
I never imagined you'd get through this training...
m300111.そうじゃな、と……あいたた……。\nそれにしても、体が随分重いのぅ……。\nまた: That's right… ouch… My body feels so heavy… If another demon shows up, it'll be terrible.
m300111.そうですね、皆さんも疲れていますし、\n今日の所はここで調査を終了して、\n王子: Indeed, everyone's tired, so let's end the investigation here for today and return to the Prince.
m300111.そこまでは流石に分かりませんが、\n大天使長が意味も無く行動してるとは思えません: I can't say for sure, but I doubt the Archangel is acting without reason.
m300111.そこまでは私も分からないです……。: I don't really know that part…
m300111.それじゃあ、わたし行かなくちゃ。\nやらないといけない事があるから……。: Then I have to go. I have something I must do…
m300111.それでは、城へ戻りましょうか……。\n今日はお疲れでしょう。しっかりとお身体を休:
Then, shall we return to the castle...?
You must be tired today. Rest well,
and tomorrow, let's train together again!
m300111.それでは王子、\n今回は少しだけ厳しくいきますよ？\nさあ、訓練開始です！:
Alright then, Prince,
this time we'll be a bit tougher, okay?
Now, the training begins!
m300111.それにしても、どうして急に\nアースエレメンタルがあんなに大量に\n発生してしま: Still, why did Earth Elementals suddenly appear in such huge numbers…?
m300111.それにしても、魔界の瘴気の影響でしょうか。\n魔力がいつもの半分程しか沸いてきま: Still, could it be the miasma? Our magic only feels about half as strong…
m300111.それをエレメンタルって呼んでいるの。\n世の中には、自然物と交信して意図的に\n: We call that an Elemental. Some people can communicate with nature and deliberately manifest them, it seems.
m300111.そんな……やはり我らでは勝てないのか……。: No… So we really can't win…?
m300111.そんなに不安そうな顔を\nなさらないでください王子。: Don't wear such an anxious face, Prince.
m300111.そんな事よりも、\nあのデーモンは私を追ってきてるの。\n早く逃げた方が良いよ。: More importantly, that demon's after me. We should get out quickly.
m300111.そんな自然物に宿るエネルギーが何かのきっかけで\n異常に集まると、ある限界点に達: When that energy suddenly gathers, it reaches a limit and then it materializes—just like that.
m300111.ただね、こっちから危害を加えなければ、\nエレメンタルは危険なものじゃないの。\: But as long as we don't attack them, Elementals aren't dangerous. So we don't have to force them away right now.
m300111.だから、裁かれるべきは己のみ……という訳か。\n都合の良い話だな。: So only I should be judged… is that it? What a convenient story.
m300111.だが、此度ノ反乱は、全てオレの罪ダ……。\n他ノ仲間達はオレが煽動し、この戦場に: …But this rebellion is all my fault. I incited the others and put them on this battlefield… that's all I want you to understand.
m300111.ちょ、ちょ、ちょっと！\nどうするのゼンメルさん！\n逃げるの！？ 戦うの！？: Wait, wait, wait! What are you doing, Zenmel! Run? Fight!?
m300111.ったく、アースエレメンタルなんか居なけりゃ\nもっと楽に勝てたのによぉ……。\n: Honestly, if those Earth Elementals weren't here, we could've won much easier. This took twice the effort…
m300111.って、あの～……。\nそのデーモンが向かって来ていますよ……。: Uh… that demon's heading straight for us…
m300111.ですが、少しも動かないですね……。\nどういう事なのでしょうか……。: But it isn't moving at all… What does that mean?
m300111.でも、確かにあんなに沢山の\nアースエレメンタルが具象化するのは\nちょっと普通: But it's definitely odd for that many Earth Elementals to materialize at once.
m300111.どうか、その力と心を、大切に育んでください。: Please, nurture that strength and heart with care.
m300111.なんと！ 魔界の住民じゃと\n瘴気の影響はないのか！ 魔界の住民にとって、\n瘴: So the residents aren't affected? For them the miasma is like air…
m300111.はぁぁ～…。\nや～っとビフロンス支配下のアンデッドを\nぜぇ～んぶ倒したわぁ～: Haaah… Finally took down all the undead under Bifrons' control…
m300111.ふむ……何とか退けられたようじゃ。\nしかし、魔界の瘴気というものは厄介じゃのぅ: Hmm… we managed to push it back. Still, that miasma is a pain. Can't draw our usual power.
m300111.ふーん。\nわたしは魔界に棲んでいるから平気だけど、\n物質界の住人は魔界の瘴気: I see. I'm fine since I live here, but you material folk are affected by the miasma.
m300111.ほう……なかなかどうしてやりよるのう。\nわしが眠っている間に、\n人間もずいぶ: Hmm… Not bad at all. While I was sleeping, humans have become quite strong.
m300111.ほら、アレだよアレ！ あの岩の塊みたいなのが\n大量発生しちまってるんだ。\nゴ: Look, that thing! Those massive rock-like lumps are spawning everywhere. They're rolling around like crazy—dangerous as hell.
m300111.まあいいでしょう。\n結果として封印されていた上位の天使を\n見つける事が出来た: Well, that's fine. As a result we managed to locate a sealed higher-ranking angel… hmm?
m300111.まだ本調子ではないが、肩慣らしには丁度良い。\n特別におぬしらの相手をしてやろう: I'm not at full strength yet, but it's perfect for a warm-up. I'll take on you specially.
m300111.まだ続けると仰るのですね。\nさすがは王子にございます！\n王国の未来を背負おう:
So you say you want to continue.
As expected of a prince!
I can feel your resolve to bear the kingdom's future!
m300111.も、もちろん知ってるに決まってんだろ！\n(初めて知ったぜ……): Of course I know that! (First time I actually learned it…)
m300111.やっぱり王子を頼らずに魔界に来るなんて\n危なかったかな……？\n私も、もうこれ:
I guess coming to the Demon World without relying on the Prince was dangerous…?
I don't think I can move any further.
m300111.わしは酒呑童子の配下たる四天王のひとりじゃ。: I am one of the Four Heavenly Kings, a subordinate of Shuten-Dōji.
m300111.わしらは魔界の調査に来たのじゃが、\n見ての通り、ピンチでな。\n体も思うように: We came to scout the Demon Realm, but as you can see, we're in a bind. My body won't cooperate.
m300111.アイギス様はあの神器を、\n王子にまだ託されてはないのかしら……。\n女神様の御: I wonder if Aegis has yet to entrust that sacred relic to the Prince… I can't gauge the goddess's will, but…
m300111.ギャギャッ！\nニンゲン、見ツケタ！ タオセ！ タオセッ！！: Gya-gya! Humans, we've spotted you! Attack! Attack!!
m300111.ゲハハハハ！\n理由は単純じゃ、人間どもよ……。\n封印から目覚めたわしを出迎え: Gehahahaha! The reason is simple, humans… It's to welcome me, who has awakened from the seal.
m300111.チッ……何て間の悪い時に現れやがんだ。\nアースエレメンタルの間を縫って進んでき: Damn… why do you have to show up at the worst possible moment. They're slipping through the Earth Elementals!
m300111.バルバス爺なら何か分かるかもしれないから、\n帰ったらすぐに聞きに行ってみるね。: If old Barbas knows anything, I'll go ask him as soon as we get back.
m300111.リッチ…見ていてくれた…？\nあなたの仇は取ったわ…。: Rich… were you watching…? I've taken your revenge…
m300111.丁度良い。\n先ほど見つけたこの上位天使の封印を解き、\n不浄な人間の浄化を行う: Perfect. I'll break the seal on this higher angel we just found and purify these impure humans.
m300111.不浄なる人間に与する堕天使のお前には、\n何も伝える事などない。\nそして、ここ: To a fallen angel like you, who consorts with impure humans, I have nothing to say. And I have no time to deal with you here.
m300111.人間と遜色無い地位……カ。\nそれが思い上がりだということを解さぬからこそ、\n:
Status equal to humans… huh.
Because you can't understand that such pride is arrogance, we've turned our fangs on the Empire!
m300111.先ほどの言葉から察するに、\n大天使長は、この上位天使の封印を\n解いたようです: From what you just said, it looks like the Archangel has broken that angel's seal.
m300111.分からないのか？\n陛下は貴様を見逃すと言っているのだ。: Don't you get it? His Highness says he'll let you go.
m300111.別の、目的……？\nいったいどんな目的なんじゃ？: Another purpose…? What could it be?
m300111.力を求めて、一体何をしようというのでしょうか。\n今後は彼らの対策も立てておきま: What are they after, power? What are they planning to do? We should start preparing a countermeasure. Prince.
m300111.勝負あったな。\nこれでもまだ我らに刃向かうか……？: That was a worthy fight. Still you keep daring to oppose us…?
m300111.千年戦争の頃からの封印なので、\n完全に封印が解除されるには、\nもう少し時間が: It's been sealed since the Millennium War, so fully releasing it will take a little more time.
m300111.国に脅威が訪れた時、\n皆を導くのは、あなたの役目なのですから。:
When a threat comes to the nation,
it will be your duty to guide everyone.
m300111.地上に眠る神獣を探す為に、\nかつての千年戦争にて封印された地を回って\nいると: We're traveling the sealed lands from the old millennium war to find the sleeping divine beasts, and all we keep finding are angels…
m300111.大丈夫ですか、王子？\n苦しいようでしたら、\n今日の訓練はここで終わりとします:
Are you alright, Prince?
If you're struggling,
we can end today's training here, okay?
m300111.天使にかかった封印を完全に解く前に\n他の地へと向かったということは、恐らく、\: Since the seal on the angel wasn't completely broken before heading elsewhere, perhaps they had some other purpose…
m300111.如何にも！\n王子よ、今一度我らと兵刃を交わす事を願う！:
Indeed!
Prince, we wish to clash swords with you once more!
m300111.完璧なネクロマンサーとして、\n私も少しは成長出来たかな…？: As a perfect necromancer, maybe I've grown a little…?
m300111.封印から、目覚めた……？\nあ、あなたは何者ですか！？: Awakened from a seal…? W-who are you?!
m300111.小娘を見捨てて逃げられるわけないじゃろうに。\n老いたとはいえ、わしも魔術師の端: I wouldn't abandon a little girl. Even old, I'm still a mage. Let me at least help.
m300111.少し私の方でも天使達の動向を探ってみます。\n王子も警戒を怠らないようにしてくだ: I'll keep investigating the angels' movements. Prince, stay on guard.
m300111.幸い、反乱による帝都の被害も僅かだ。\nそれに、現在の帝国軍における竜人種の重要: Fortunately, the damage to the capital from the rebellion was minimal. Moreover, given the draconians' importance to the current Imperial army, the punishment should be light.
m300111.待っていたぞ、王子！: We've been waiting for you, Prince!
m300111.待ってください！\nあの鎖で繋がれている者……、\nあれは、封印された上位天使で: Wait! The one chained there… that's a sealed higher-ranking angel.
m300111.我ら竜人族は、神と並ぶ存在である神竜ノ血を\n宿す種族ダ！ そんな我らが人間ども:
We, the dragonfolk, carry the blood of the Divine Dragon, a lineage beside the gods!
It's only natural we resent being treated on the same level as humans.
m300111.戻ったら、すぐに訓練しましょう！\n王子も、もちろん付き合って下さいね？: When we get back, let's start training right away! Prince, you'll join me, won't you?
m300111.挑発にお乗りにならぬよう、陛下……。\nここは我々だけで充分です。: Your Majesty, please don't take the bait… This is enough for us alone.
m300111.武勇に優れた王子と戦う事で、\n我らはさらに強くなる！\nそして、頭目たる鬼刃姫:
By battling a brave Prince like you,
we become even stronger!
And we will fulfill the ambition of our leader, the Oni Blade Princess...!
m300111.無事、王子の元に帰ったようね。\nまさか王子に内緒で、魔界に来るなんて。:
We made it back to the Prince safely.
I can't believe you came to the Demon World without his knowledge.
m300111.照れることはありません。むしろ誇るべきです！\n何故なら、あなたは先代にも引けを:
No need to be embarrassed. In fact, you should be proud!
Because you possess talent that rivals even the previous generation.
m300111.王子、あの天使の封印が解除される前に、\n無力化しましょう。このまま放っておくと: Prince, before that angel's seal is fully broken, we need to neutralize it. If we let it be, it'll be unleashed onto the surface!
m300111.王子、ご覧下さい！\n報告通り、この地にて鬼が暴れているようです。: Prince, look! As reported, demons are rampaging in this area.
m300111.王子、分かってると思うけど、\nアースエレメンタルには、\n絶対に手を出しちゃダ: Prince, you know this, right? Never lay a hand on an Earth Elemental!
m300111.王子、魔神が後退していきます！: Prince, the demon god is retreating!
m300111.王子！ こっちの洞窟じゃ！\n身体がピカピカ光った\n怪しいヤツが現れたんじゃ…: Prince! Over here in the cave! A shady guy whose body is shining brightly appeared…!
m300111.現れたな、帝国ノ皇帝……。\n反旗ヲ翻したのは、貴様と戦う為でもあったのダ。:
So the Emperor of the Empire finally appears…
We raised the banner of rebellion also to fight you.
m300111.皆さん、お疲れ様でした。\nそれにしても、本当に手強い相手でした。: Everyone, good work. That was truly a tough opponent.
m300111.確かに、そうですね……。\nもし、今デーモンが現れたら……。: That's true… If a demon showed up now…
m300111.確かに岩の塊のような見た目ですね。\n……いったいあれは何なのでしょうか？: They do look like chunks of rock… What on earth could that be?
m300111.私はダーリン…いえ、仲間達のおかげで、\n人間として前に進む事が出来たわ…。: Thanks to my darling… no, my comrades, I can move forward as a human…
m300111.私達は無益な戦いはしません！\nなぜ、こんなに執拗に王子を付け狙うのですか！？:
We won't fight a pointless battle!
Why are you so obsessively targeting the Prince?!
m300111.臆するのなら退くも良シ……。\nだが、真に我らを従えていたと自負するならば、\n:
If you're scared, you may retreat…
But if you truly believe you command us, then face me in an honorable duel!
m300111.自分も同感であります！\n幼くしてこれほどの軍略を駆使するとは……。\n王国の未:
I feel the same way!
To wield such strategy at such a young age...
The kingdom's future looks bright!
m300111.要するに帝国に収まる器ではないと\n言いたいのだな。……だが、ここを出てどうする:
In short, you're saying you're not meant to be confined by the Empire…
But what will you do after you leave? Do you even have anywhere to go?
m300111.誇リ高き竜人族ノ戦士達ヨ！\n我らは神竜ノ血を引く優れた種族ダ！\n今コソ人間に:
Behold, proud warriors of the Dragonfolk!
We are a noble race bearing the blood of the Divine Dragon!
Now we'll show those lowly humans our power!
m300111.貴方は……大天使長！？\nいえ、それよりも何故このようなところに！？\nまた、物: You are… the Archangel!? No, more importantly, why are you here?! Are you trying to intervene in the material world again…?
m300111.身体から光を……？\n本当にそのような者がいるのでしょうか？: His body is glowing…? Could such a person really exist?
m300111.酒呑童子の配下の四天王……！？\nかなりの強敵であることは間違いありませんね…。: A Four Heavenly King, subordinate of Shuten-Dōji…? No doubt they're a formidable foe. Prince, please command carefully.
m300111.陛下……！？ そう、ですか。\n奴等と真っ向から戦うというのですね。\n分かりま:
Your Majesty…! I see. So we'll confront them head-on.
Understood. We'll give them our full support.
m300111.頭目？ 鬼刃姫……？\n一体どういう事ですか？: Head? Kibahime...? What on earth does this mean?
m300111.鬼刃姫、ですか……。\nなぜか自分達の鍛錬の相手に\n王子を選んでいた様ですが…: Kibahime, huh… Somehow they chose the Prince as their training partner…
m300111.鬼刃衆！ いつまで倒れてるつもり？\nさっさと退くよ。: Oni Blade Squad! How long do you plan on lying there? Get out of the way already.
m300111.魔界のネクロマンサーなら\n魔界で大人しくしていなさいよね！\nまた来てもダーリ: If you're a necromancer of the demon realm, you should stay put there! If they come back, Darling and I will drive them away!
m300111.魔界の人なのに、優しく綺麗な眼だったね。\n悪い事をする人には見えないけど……。:
Even though you're from the Demon World, you had kind, beautiful eyes.
They don't show on those who do evil…
m300111.魔神ビフロンスを撃退出来て本当に良かったです。\nそれでは帰還するとしましょう。: I'm really glad we repelled Bifrons. Let's head back then.

m300158.――この辺りになります。\n新種の魔物の報告があったというのは。: ――This is the area. They said there were reports of a new kind of monster nearby.
m300158.――まったく、男同士で交流を深める会、\nと聞いていましたが……。: —Really, a gathering for men to deepen their bonds, they said…
m300158.――王子、交流会の会場はこの先です。\n皆さん先に向かわれるとの事でしたが……。: —Prince, the venue for the gathering is just ahead. I heard everyone's heading there first…
m300158.……そうですね。指導については、\n目が覚めてから行うとしましょうか。: …Indeed. As for the instruction, shall we do it after we wake up?
m300158.……既にしっかり盛り上がってるようです。\nそれでは、自分も混ざらせて頂きます。: …Looks like the party's already in full swing. Then, allow me to join in.
m300158.……流石は王子。歴戦の手腕、見せてもらったよ。\nそして砲術隊の皆もありがとう。: …As expected of the Prince. You showed the skill of a veteran. And thanks to the artillery crew as well. We were defeated, but it was a fight with no regrets.
m300158.……程々にお願いするわね。\nそれじゃ王子、戻りましょ。: …Don't overdo it. Well then, Prince, let's head back.
m300158.ああ、もちろん把握している。\nこれなら怪我の心配もないし、\n気兼ねなく全力で: Of course, I'm aware. That means no risk of injury, and we can go all-out without holding back!
m300158.あの、イブキさん？\n弾は水風船を使った船上演習ですからね？: Um, Ibuki-san? The shells are just water-balloon drills on the ship, right?
m300158.いやいやいや、男と言えばやはり筋肉。\nこの鍛え抜かれし肉体を見て下され。\n…: No, no, no—when it comes to men, it's all about the muscles. Behold this honed physique! …Hmph!
m300158.うぅ、飲みすぎた……ぜ……。\n頭の中でドラが鳴り響いてやがる……。: Ugh, I overdid it… My head's pounding like a drum…
m300158.うーん、もう飲めませんよ……ぐぅ。: Hmm, I can't drink any more… *groan*
m300158.おう野郎ども、こっちだぜ！\nこの先の屋台が俺の店だ。\n美味い酒と料理を楽しん: Hey, you bastards, over here! This stall ahead is my shop. Enjoy some tasty booze and grub.
m300158.おぉ、いい考えじゃねーか！ 酒もある事だし\nアレを見せる事も出来そうだ……。\: Oh, great idea! We've got the booze, and we can show it off… Prince, it's been a while—let's go all-out in a duel!
m300158.おぉ！ 王子殿ではありませんか！\nちょうどよかった！ 今皆で誰が一番男らしいか: Oh! Isn't it the Prince himself! Perfect timing! We were just debating who's the most manly!
m300158.ここの酒は城で飲む酒とは違うなぁ。\n凄いアルコールが強い感じがするけど、\n口: The booze here's nothing like what we drink back at the castle. It hits hard, but it's so smooth I could keep going forever!
m300158.すみませんダニエラさん、\n今日は非番だったというのに\nご協力頂いてしまって。: I'm sorry, Daniela. You weren't even on duty today, yet you're helping us.
m300158.そうだぜ！ 男同士、\n同じ釜の飯を食い、酒を酌み交わす！\nまさに友情だぜ！: That's right! Men sharing a pot of rice, passing around drinks—that's true friendship!
m300158.そうね。負けたのは残念だけど、\n全力を尽くす、悔いの無い戦いができたわ。: Indeed. It's a shame we lost, but we gave it our all and have no regrets.
m300158.それにその大砲を使いこなす技術……\nイブキさんでしたら、砲術士としても\nやっ: And the skill to wield that cannon… I think you could hold your own as an artillery specialist, Ibuki-san.
m300158.ちょっと、\n幾らなんでも気が抜けすぎなんじゃないの。\nいつ敵が現れるか――…: Hey, this is getting way too lax. We never know when the enemy will appear——!
m300158.どうでしょうダニエラさん、\n何か見えますか？: How about it, Daniela? Do you see anything?
m300158.どうやら敵は去ったようです。: It looks like the enemy has retreated.
m300158.はい……ですが、激戦の日々の中、\n皆さん良い息抜きになったようで何よりです。: Yes... but amidst these days of fierce battles, I'm glad it served as a good break for everyone.
m300158.はい、それがよさそうです。\n皆さん今はしっかりと疲れを癒されて下さいね。\nお: Yes, that sounds best. Please take the time to properly recover your fatigue now. Good work, everyone.
m300158.はい。またいつ人魚が現れても問題なきよう、\n今後は海上を想定した戦闘訓練も、\: Yes. We'll need to incorporate sea-combat training so we're ready if a siren appears again.
m300158.ふふっ、まさか王子軍を相手に戦う日がくるとは。\n英雄率いる歴戦の強者との戦い…: Heh, I never imagined the day I'd face the Prince's forces. A battle against seasoned heroes led by a legend… No shortage of challenge, I'm truly looking forward to it.
m300158.ふわぁ……凄く綺麗な歌声ですね。\n思わず聞き入ってしまいます……それに何だか…: Wow… What a beautiful voice. I can't help but get drawn in… and somehow… I feel my strength just… slipping away…
m300158.まぁそう慌てなさんな。\nお酒も料理も逃げませんぞ。: Hey, no need to rush. The drinks and food aren't going anywhere.
m300158.まぁロイ殿、楽しみに歩が軽くなるのは人として当然の事。\n武を極め、酒をたしなむ: Indeed, Roy, it's only natural for a man to feel lighter when he looks forward to a feast. Master the sword, savor the drink—it's what a man should do. All that's missing is a bit of flair.
m300158.まったく、厄介な能力を備えた魔物が現れたわね。\n海上をチョロチョロして、ほんと: Good grief, a monster with such a troublesome ability shows up. Skittering around the sea—so annoying.
m300158.もちろんだ。\n新参者に指揮を執らせて頂き感謝している。\n采配、号令を以て私の: Naturally. I'm grateful to have a newcomer take the reins. With my orders and commands, I'll demonstrate my true skill.
m300158.やっぱ男なら酒は強くなくっちゃな！\n見ろよ、この豪快な飲みっぷりを！\n……ゲ: A real man has to hold his liquor! Look at this wild drinking! …Ughhh.
m300158.ハープを持った魔物……成程そういう事か。\nこの歌は、どうやら人魚の使う呪歌のよ: A monster with a harp… I see. This song must be a siren's chant.
m300158.人魚の呪歌……そういう事ですか。男性の方々は、\n前線に出るのは危険やもしれませ: Siren's chant… I get it. It's dangerous to send the men to the front line. Let's handle this ourselves, the women.
m300158.人魚の歌声は、男性を魅了し力を出せなくする。\n人魚がいる間、男連中は\n全く使: Siren songs enchant men and drain their power. While a siren's present, the men are completely useless, so we'd better keep that in mind.
m300158.今回は男だけの交流会、\n女性が居ないのは仕方ないさ。: This one's a men-only gathering, after all. No women, but that's how it goes.
m300158.山賊王さんの作られる山賊料理、\nすっごく楽しみです！ \nよぉっし、お腹いっぱ: I'm really looking forward to the Bandit King's specialty dishes! Alright, let's eat till we're stuffed!
m300158.帰り次第、新たな特訓メニューを考案せねばなりません。\nまずは浜辺での行軍をスム: Once we get back, we'll have to devise a new training regimen. First, we need to smooth out our beach marches—maybe a 10-kilometer… no, 100-kilometer drill on sand.
m300158.新種の魔物ねぇ……見る限り、\n特にそれらしいのは\n見当たらないみたいだけど…: A new monster, huh… From what I can see, there's nothing that looks like it…
m300158.気にしないで頂戴、弓兵の目がないと\n海上の魔物を探すなんて出来ないでしょ。\n: Don't worry about it. Without the archers' eyes, we couldn't even spot sea monsters. …Huh? Did you hear something?
m300158.演習と言っても、\nやるからには負けるつもりはありません。\n海軍元帥の采配、期: Even if it's a drill, I have no intention of losing. I'll be counting on the Admiral's command.
m300158.演習部隊に砲術隊を選ぶなんてわかってるじゃない。\n王子には悪いけど、手加減はな: Choosing the artillery unit for a drill—how predictable. Sorry to the Prince, but I won't be going easy on you!
m300158.王子、戦闘のご指示をお願いします。\n王子も男性です、前線に立つような無茶は\n: Prince, please give us your battle orders. You're a man too, so don't do anything reckless like charging the front.
m300158.王子たちの強さと指揮が一枚上手だったわね。\n……でも、イブキの指揮も流石だった: The Prince's strength and command were a cut above. …But Ibuki's leadership was impressive too.
m300158.王子軍たるもの、訓練や風紀は当然の事、\n礼節にも通じて貰わねばなりません。\n: As members of the Prince's forces, training, discipline, and proper conduct are a given. We must also uphold etiquette. Looks like we need another lesson.
m300158.男らしさと言えば、やはり\n隙のない剣技につきるだろう。\n全てにおいて、俺に隙: When you talk manliness, it's all about flawless swordsmanship. I've got no gaps in anything!
m300158.砲術士では無いけれど、\nイブキさんの大砲も良い武器ですね！: I'm not an artilleryman, but your cannon, Ibuki-san, is a fine weapon!
m300158.砲術士の皆、配置についたようだな。\nよし、私も出撃する！ 『一斉射撃』開始！\: Artillerymen, you're in position, I see. Alright, I'm moving out! Commencing ‘simultaneous fire'! Prince… this is it!
m300158.私の号令に合わせ、皆存分に\nその全力を発揮して貰えればと思う。\nそれでは……: If everyone can give it their all in sync with my command, that'd be great. Now then… let the drill begin!
m300158.私も負けてられないわね。\n砲術士の学校で学んだ成果を見せてあげるわ。: I can't afford to lose either. I'll show you the results of my training at the artillery school.
m300158.言ってる傍から敵襲みたいね！\n向こうの方角から魚人の群れが接近中、\n……それ: It sounds like an ambush! A school of merfolk is approaching from that direction… and there's a new monster wielding a harp, too.
m300158.酒の強さと腕の強さ……男子たるものどちらも備えていて\n当然のもの。ここはひとつ: Strength of drink and strength of arm—both are essential for a true man. So, let's drink and see who can stand up to the Prince; that's what makes a man, right?

m300333.――いや待て。先に伝えることがある。\n助手君、きみには容疑者の\n証言をしっか:
—No, wait. There's something I need to tell you first.
Assistant, I'm going to need you to carefully scrutinize the
suspects' testimonies.
m300333.――おっと、違うぞ助手君。\nリュティエは犯人をかばっている！:
――Ah, no, that's not it, Assistant.
Luthier is covering up for the real culprit!
m300333.――こうして、ひとつの事件が終わる。\n次の事件は東か西か、北か南か！\n名探偵:
――And so, one case comes to a close.
Will the next case be in the east, the west, the north, or the south?
Detective Anabella's mystery drama continues!
m300333.――ここが通報のあった、邪教徒の隠れ家ですか。\n街の中に潜伏しているとは、大胆:
――So this is the hideout of the cultists we were called to investigate.
Hiding in plain sight in the middle of town… quite bold of them.
m300333.――そこまで！\nこの戦い、勝者は……ッ！:
――That's enough!
The winner of this battle is…!
m300333.――どんどん、ぱふぱふ、にゃんにゃかにゃーん♪\n第１回、王国紅白大合戦、開催だ:
――Dun-dun, puff-puff, nya-nya-nya-nyaaan♪
The 1st Kingdom Red-and-White Grand Melee is about to begin~♪
m300333.――ゆえに、どうしても第三勢力になりたいなら、\nどちらも選ばず制限時間を待つと:
――Therefore, if you absolutely must remain a third party,
you can choose neither and simply wait for the time limit!
m300333.――ツー、お前だったか。\nこちらの動向に気付いていたのか。\nここまでの仕込み:
—So it was you, Two.
You were aware of our movements.
Our preparations up to this point have been ruined.
m300333.――仁義、仁義か。\nならばその仁義とやらで、\n私の武技に打ち勝ってみせるがい:
—Honor, is it?
Then let that honor of yours
try to overcome my martial arts.
m300333.――待て待て待て！\n王子、降伏する！ お前たちも落ち着け！:
――Wait, wait, wait!
Prince, I surrender! Everyone, calm down!
m300333.――新年の王城、盗まれたデシウス人形、\n４人の容疑者、そこに現れるは名探偵！:
—The New Year's Royal Palace, the stolen Desius doll,
four suspects, and then, the great detective makes her appearance!
m300333.…………いや、気のせいだろう。\nともかく、このアジトの捜索を始めよう。\n何か:
…No, it's probably just my imagination.
Anyway, let's begin searching this hideout.
Hopefully, some evidence is still here.
m300333.…………吾輩、サボってていいかのう？: …………Do you think I can just slake off here?
m300333.……この慌てよう、大当たりみたいね。\n王子、ガサイレ開始よ！:
……Judging by the panic, we must have hit the mark.
Prince, let's begin the search!
m300333.……そこに吾輩も巻き込まれたと？: ……And I've been dragged into it as well, you say?
m300333.……なんじゃ？\nすごい足音が聞こえてくるんじゃが……。:
……What is that?
I can hear the sound of heavy footsteps approaching…
m300333.……もう、隠すことはできないでしょう。\n我々は魔王ガリウス様の人形を作っていた:
……There's no point in hiding it anymore.
We were making figures of Demon Lord Galius.
m300333.……堂々と、ヒットリストに\n加えると宣言していきやがった。:
……He boldly declared that he would
add us to his hit list.
m300333.……大変そうだな、王子。: ……Looks like you're in for it, Prince.
m300333.……組織は変わらねばならなかった。\nはぐれ者の互助組織など、長続きするはずもな:
……The organization had to change.
A mutual aid group for outcasts could never last.
You must have understood that, Irene.
m300333.……魔王だって？\n魔王ガリウスの信奉者ってことかしら。:
……The Demon Lord?
Are you followers of Demon Lord Galius?
m300333.──悪ふざけはそこまでだ、占星術師。\nお前がお年玉を知らん訳がないだろうが。:
──Enough with the prank, Astronomer.
There's no way you wouldn't know what otoshidama means.
m300333.──破魔矢を射ってたんですか？ 何故？: ──So you were shooting the hamaya? Why?
m300333.「にゃはは、私は犯人じゃないですよ」\n疑うなんて酷いです！:
“Nyahaha, I'm not the culprit!”
How could you even suspect me? That's so mean!
m300333.「バシラは絶対に犯人じゃないです」\n当然ですよね？:
“Bashira is definitely not the culprit.”
That's only natural, right?
m300333.「リュティエは犯人ではありません」\n真犯人をかばっているんです。:
“Luthier is not the culprit.”
He's covering up for the real one.
m300333.ああ。お前はまだ、失うには惜しい男だからな。\n金の稼ぎ方というものがよく分かっ:
Ah. You are still a man too valuable to lose.
You know how to make money well.
Now, hurry and run.
m300333.あっ……夢が静かになっていきますね。\nどうやら、激戦の振り返りが終わったようで:
Ah… the dream is growing quiet.
It seems the replay of the fierce battles has come to an end.
m300333.あの御方の側近自ら、か……。\n伝説の戦い方を見られないのが心残りだが、\n先に:
The Prince's own aide……
I regret not getting to see that legendary fighting style,
but I'll be taking my leave.
m300333.ありがたきお言葉……。\nこれで魔王様の威光を、\n物質界に広めることができるで:
I'm deeply grateful for your kind words…
With this, we can surely spread the Demon Lord's glory
into the material world.
m300333.いえ、こちらも調査不足でしたから。\n双方けが人がいなくて何よりです。:
No, no. Our investigation was lacking, too.
It's a good thing nobody got hurt.
m300333.いずれは激突する相手だ、気にするなセブン。\n――しかし、何か引っかかるな……。:
We will clash with him eventually, so don't worry, Seven.
—But, something is bothering me…….
m300333.いやいや、怪しまれることをしたのはこちらだから――: No, no, we're the ones who made you suspicious—
m300333.うぅ……バレていましたか。\n閃いた瞬間は王子くんっぽくて、\n面白いかなーと思:
Uu… so it was obvious, huh.
The moment the idea hit me, it felt so like the Prince,
I thought it might be fun.
m300333.うぅぅぅ、仕方ない！ おーい！ 皆の者ー！！\n王子の悪夢を蹴散らすのじゃー！！:
Uuuuugh, I suppose I have no choice!
Hey, everyone—!!
Let's smash the Prince's nightmare to pieces—!!
m300333.うむ。助手君、焦ってしまったんだろうね。\nリエーフは犯人ではない。:
Yes. You must have panicked, Assistant.
Lev is not the culprit.
m300333.うむっ、解説のガオレオンであるッ！\n熱く激しく輝きに満ちた戦いを期待するッ！！:
Um! I am Gaoleon, your commentator!
I look forward to a hot, fierce, and dazzling battle!!
m300333.うむっ。\nでは吾輩たちも、夢から覚めるとしようかの♪:
Mm.
Then let us all wake from this dream, shall we?♪
m300333.うむむ、これは迷ってしまうな……。\nどちらとも戦いたいッ、その気持ちは分かるぞ:
Um, um, this is a tough choice…
I want to fight both of them! I understand that feeling!
m300333.うん……絶対に勝ちましょう。\n王子と一緒に、目指せ優勝です。:
Yes… we absolutely have to win.
With the Prince by our side, let's aim for the championship!
m300333.えぇ、頼りにしています！\nそれではさっそく、容疑者の証言を――:
Yes, we're counting on you!
Then, let's get right to it and hear the suspects' testimonies—
m300333.えぇっ、それはさすがに悪いような……。: E-eh? That seems a bit too much…
m300333.ええ、おとし弾だそうです。\n東の国に古くから伝わる文化で、\n厄除けの意味があ:
Yes, it's called an otoshidama.
It's a tradition from the Eastern lands,
supposedly meant to ward off bad luck.
m300333.ええ、皆さんお疲れさまでした。\n後片付けはこちらで担当しますので、\n皆さん体:
Yes, everyone did a great job.
I'll take care of the cleanup, so please make sure not to catch a cold.
m300333.えっと……それでは、全力でいきますね？: Um… well then, I'm going to give it my all, okay?
m300333.えっと、私たちも一緒に行っても……？: Um, can we come along too…?
m300333.おい王子、約束は覚えているな。\nさっさとお年玉を寄越すがいい。: Hey, Prince. Don't forget our deal. Hand over that New Year's money, will you?
m300333.おお、来てくれましたか名探偵アナベラ！\nしかし今回の事件は難しいですよ……。\:
Oh, you've arrived, Detective Anabella!
But this case is a tricky one…….
After all, there are four suspects……!
m300333.おっと、なんじゃレーヴではないか。\nいったいこの珍妙な場所は何なのじゃ。:
Oh my, isn't that Reve?
Just what is this peculiar place, I wonder.
m300333.おっと、違うぞ助手君。\n焦ってしまったのかな？:
Ah, no, that's not it, Assistant.
Did you get flustered?
m300333.くっ、怪盗サバルが逃走する！\n追え！ 追えーっ！！:
Curses! Phantasm Saval is escaping!
After them! After them!!
m300333.こういう戦いも悪くない、かな。\nいつもは命をかけた戦いばかりだけれど、\nこれ:
Battles like this aren't bad, I suppose.
Usually, it's always life-or-death combat, but
this way, we can actually have some fun.
m300333.ここが怪盗サバルの犯行現場か……。\nまさかあの至宝、デシウス人形を盗み出すとは:
So this is Phantom Thief Sabar's crime scene…….
To think he would steal that treasure, the Desius doll.
m300333.こちらが今回の容疑者、\nリュティエ殿、リエーフ殿、テティス殿、バシラ殿だ。:
These are the suspects in this case:
Lord Luthier, Lord Lev, Lady Tethys, and Lady Bashira.

...That enemy with the big shield.
We should keep an eye on it.
m500155.……やはり、通常の武器では\n効果が見込めませんか。: …so, as expected, conventional weapons won't be effective.
m500155.……黒鎧の魔神、キメリエス。\n彼の魔神が再び地上に現れたと見て\n間違いないで: …the black-armored demon god, Kimeries. I'm certain his demon has resurfaced on the surface.
m500155.『その漆黒の槍の前には如何なる堅固な盾も、\n魔法の護りも無意味である』と。: “Before that jet-black spear, no shield, however sturdy, nor any magical protection, will matter.”
m500155.あのような盾から攻撃を受けては、\n意識を保つ事も困難でしょう。: Getting hit by a shield like that would make it hard to stay conscious.
m500155.あれだけの痛手を負わせたのです。\nしばらく魔界から動くことはできないでしょう。:
We've inflicted such a grievous wound.
They won't be able to move from the demon realm for a while.
m500155.いざという時は、\n私達付与魔術師の力も使うと良いわ。\n皆の武器に、魔法の力を: When the time comes, we can also use our enchantment magic. We'll imbue everyone's weapons with magical power.
m500155.この言葉の意味する所はまだ判りません……ですが、\n微塵の油断もならない相手であ: I don't fully understand the meaning yet… but there's no doubt this opponent allows no margin for error. Please remain vigilant.
m500155.そう願いたいものじゃの。\nあんな怪物が暴れまわっては\nおちおち余生も過ごせん:
I hope that's the case.
We can't have that monster running amok and ruining our peaceful retirement.
m500155.た、助かりました……キメリエス、\nそれにその眷属の能力下にある鎧の硬さは、\n: We… we were saved… Kimeries, and the armor hardened by his minions' abilities, is far beyond normal.
m500155.はい……皆さんが無事で、\n本当に良かった。: Yes... I'm so glad everyone is safe.
m500155.はい、皆さんよろしくお願いします。\n王子、戦闘のご指示をお願いします！: Yes, everyone, thank you. Prince, please give us your battle orders!
m500155.また文献には、\n『真の脅威は魔の軍馬を駆り、槍を振るう姿にある』\nとの記載も: The texts also mention, “The true threat lies in the figure wielding demonic warhorses and spears.”
m500155.やはりここは、\n我々魔法を使える者の出番のようですな。\n魔法の力を侮らないこ: It seems this is the moment for those of us who can use magic. Never underestimate magical power!
m500155.キメリエス……更には\nその眷属の力までもが加わった鎧の前には、\n並大抵の物理: Kimeries… moreover, with his minions' strength added to his armor, ordinary physical attacks would be virtually useless.
m500155.キメリエスが退いていくようだ。\nひとまず、危機は去ったと言えるだろう。: It looks like Kimeries is retreating. For now, we can say the crisis has passed.
m500155.兵士の鍛錬、チーム編成の見直し、\n可能な限りの準備を行った上で、\n戦いへと臨: Train the soldiers, rethink team composition, prepare as much as possible, and then go into battle.
m500155.報告によれば、軍勢を率いている魔神は、\n黒き鎧を身に纏った、\n騎士のような姿: According to the report, the demon god leading the army is clad in black armor and looks like a knight.
m500155.奴が何度蘇ろうと問題ないよう、\n我々ももっと力をつけねばなりませんね。\n……:
No matter how many times it resurrects, we need to become stronger ourselves.
...But for now, let's celebrate this victory.
m500155.幾ら剣で攻撃しようと、ただ刃が欠けるばかり。\n有効打を与えられているとは、\n: No matter how we strike with swords, the blades just chip away. I don't think we can land any effective hits…
m500155.文献によれば、キメリエスの力は自身に与する\n鎧の力を引き上げ、その硬度を高める: Texts say Kimeries can amplify the power of his armor, increasing its hardness, and that this power also extends to his minions.
m500155.王子、正面から受けるのは危険かと。\n慎重なご采配をお願いします。:
Prince, taking it head-on would be dangerous.
Please act cautiously.
m500155.王子、此度の戦いにおいては魔法を主体とした\n皆様の力が有効かと思われます。しっ: Prince, in this battle you'll need to rely on magic. Your forces' magical power should be effective. We must devise solid countermeasures and face the fight.
m500155.王子、緊急の事態です。魔界より、\n鎧の軍勢を率いた魔神が出現したとの\n報告が: Prince, we have an emergency. Reports have come in that a demon god leading an armored army has appeared from the demon realm.
m500155.王子も、此度の激戦でさぞお疲れでしょう。\n城へと戻りゆっくり休まれて下さい。:
Prince, you must be exhausted after that fierce battle.
Return to the castle and rest.
m500155.皆、我々が来るまで良く耐えてくれました。\n戦況はどうなっていますか？: Everyone held out well until we arrived. What's the current situation?
m500155.見た処、武器のような物も持っていない。\n恐らくあの盾自体が、\n武器のような物:
From what I saw, it didn't have any weapon.
I think the shield itself is its weapon.

m910001.――王子、プラクティスクエストへようこそ！: — Prince, welcome to the practice quest!
m910001.あれはご褒美のつもりなので。\n次はもっと倒せるように、がんばってくださいね♪: That was meant as a reward. Next time, try to defeat even more, okay?♪
m910001.あれ？ いつもの「ざこざこ～」っていうの、\n言ってあげないの？: Huh? Aren't you going to say the usual “so weak~”?
m910001.うんうん、がんばりましたねー。: Yeah, yeah, you did your best.
m910001.ここでは、制限時間内に\nどれだけ多くの敵を撃破できるかを試す、\nタイムアタッ: Here you can take on a time-attack, seeing how many foes you can defeat within the limit.
m910001.ここは、味方が放つ範囲攻撃が、\nどこまで効果を及ぼすのかを確認できる演習場です: This area lets you see how far your allies' area attacks reach.
m910001.ここは味方との連携や、\n個人での武技を試すことのできる演習場です。: This is the training grounds where you can test teamwork with allies and practice your individual combat skills.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「物理攻撃」をしてきます。: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use physical attacks.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「防御力」と「魔法耐性」の\n両方を: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use attacks that ignore both defense and magical resistance.
m910001.ここは味方の耐久力を試す演習場で、\n木人が「防御力を無視した攻撃」をしてきます: This area tests your allies' durability; the dummies will use attacks that ignore defense.
m910001.ここは空を飛ぶ敵との\n戦闘を想定した演習場です。: This training ground is set up for battles against airborne enemies.
m910001.すごいすごーい！ 全部倒しちゃった！: Amazing, amazing! I cleared them all!
m910001.また、見通しのよい櫓も用意しました。\n射程が延長されますので、\n癒し手を配置: We've also set up a clear-view tower. Its extended range lets you position healers to keep your team topped up.
m910001.もし途中で演習を中断したくなった場合には、\n私の前に兵を配置し、その旨を伝えて: If you need to pause the drill, just place a soldier in front of me and let me know.
m910001.わぁっ、ざこざこなのに頑張りましたねー♪: Wow, you did great even though they were so weak~♪
m910001.後半になるほど木人や、彫像の強さも増していきます。\nぜひ、１００体すべての撃破: As the battle goes on, the wooden dummies and statues get stronger. Aim to take down all one hundred of them.
m910001.挑戦は何度も受け付けております。\n如何なる戦術、如何なる武技が見られるのか！\: We welcome challenges over and over. What tactics, what techniques will you show? Please enjoy what's ahead!
m910001.攻撃力は看板に書かれていますので、\n試してみたい木人の前に兵を配置してください: Their attack power is listed on the signboards—place your troops in front of the dummy you want to try.
m910001.木人からすれば、\nここで訓練した者は戦友も同然。\n強さを見せれば喜ぶのも道理: From a dummy's perspective, anyone who trains here is practically a comrade. It's only natural they'd be pleased to see strength.
m910001.木人たちも嬉しそうですね。\nぴょんぴょん跳ね回っています。: The wooden dummies look happy too. They're hopping around.
m910001.爆風を伴う攻撃などのチェックに、\nぜひ活用してください。: Feel free to use it to check things like explosions.
m910001.１０分が経過するか、木人を撃破すると、\nこの演習は終了となります。: The exercise ends after ten minutes or when you defeat all the training dummies.

m920029.……あ！ お主らは！ 丁度よい！\n頼む、わしの同胞を止めてくれぬか！？\nもは: …Ah! You there! Perfect timing! Please, stop my kin! My words can't reach them any longer…
m920029.……いえ、お礼には及びません。\nあなた達が安心して暮らせるなら、\n私達はそれ: …No, there's no need to thank us. As long as you can live in peace, that's enough for us.
m920029.……だが、一部の竜人たちはそうもいかぬ。\nあやつらのように共存に反対し、武力を: …However, some drakes won't accept that. There are those who oppose coexistence and try to subjugate us by force.
m920029.……またお前らか！\nお宝があるところに必ず現れやがるんだな。\nさては俺らの宝: …You again! You always show up wherever there's treasure. You're here to steal ours, aren't you?!
m920029.……分かりました。\nあなた方の目は澄んでいます。\n嘘偽りなど無いと信じましょ: I understand. Your eyes are sincere. I'll trust there's no deceit.
m920029.……王子！\n今日は私も前線に立たせてください……！: …Prince! Please let me stand on the front lines today as well…!
m920029.……！ ライバルが来やがったな。\nこりゃネバネバの相手なんてしてる場合じゃねぇ:
…! A rival shows up.
This isn't the time to be dealing with slime.
m920029.……！ 魔物！ こんな時に！\n英霊となった彼らにゆっくり花をたむける事さえ\n: …! Monsters! At a time like this! They won't even let us take a moment to lay flowers for those who became heroes…
m920029.…しかし、なにか小さいようじゃな。\nまぁいい！\n持ち帰るにはちょうど良い大き: …But it looks a bit small. Oh well! It's the perfect size to bring back!
m920029.あ、お前！\n話が違うじゃねーか！\nお宝なんかどこにもなかったぞ！: Hey, you! That's not what happened! There was never any treasure!
m920029.ああ！ 思い出したわ！\nたしか宝探しを手伝ってくれた王子様ご一行ね！\nお陰様: Ah! I remember now! You're the Prince's party that helped with the treasure hunt! Thanks to you, we made a killing back then.
m920029.あいつらもネバネバも倒して\n俺たちゃ大金持ちだ！: If we take down those pirates and the slime, we'll be filthy rich!
m920029.あなたあの時の……！: You... you were there back then!
m920029.あなたにはこっそり教えちゃう。\nその代わりまた手伝ってよね！: I'll tell you in secret, but you'll have to help me out again, okay?
m920029.あなたの代わりはいないのです。\nですがあなたには沢山の仲間がいる。: There's no one who can take your place. But you have many allies.
m920029.あなたは……竜人の大長老！: You're… the Grand Elder of the drakes!
m920029.あなたは……！\nあの時の海賊さんではないですか！: You…! Aren't you that pirate from back then?
m920029.あの時、人間はやっぱり優しいんだ、\n私の思ってた事は間違ってなかったんだって\: Back then, I was convinced that humans are truly kind, that my doubts were wrong.
m920029.あの時王子が助けてくれなかったら、\n人間と竜人は今でもずっと\n戦い続けていた: If the Prince hadn't saved us then, humans and drakes would still be locked in endless war today...
m920029.あの暗く湿った抜け道だけが\n私の最後の希望でした。: That dark, damp secret passage was my last hope.
m920029.あの炎の魔物は……召喚獣……？！\nあれは、召喚士でないと扱う事は出来ないはず！: That fiery monster… a summoned beast?! Only a summoner should be able to control it!
m920029.あの魔物は強力な魔法の力で攻撃してきます！: That monster attacks with powerful magic!
m920029.あら？ あなた達どこかで見た気がするわ。: Oh? I think I've seen you somewhere before.
m920029.あれ、お宝なかったんだ。うーん。\nとりつくされちゃったのかしらね。前に来た時は: Oh, there was no treasure? Huh… Maybe we were possessed. When we came before, nobody knew about this place yet.
m920029.あんな魔物の相手してたら\n命がいくつあっても足りゃしねぇ！\nさっさと王子ども:
Dealing with a monster like that, no matter how many lives you have, ain't enough!
We'll just cut down the Prince and make a run for it…!
m920029.いいえ、お気になさらず。\nこれからも気を付けてくださいね。: No, don't mention it. Please stay safe from now on.
m920029.う、うるせぇな。\nお宝への期待が高まりすぎて\n体がほてってきたって意味だよ！: Shut up! My excitement over the treasure's got my blood heating up!
m920029.うむ。あの時の巫女の行動がなければ\n戦いは続き、数に劣る竜人の敗北に\n終わっ: Indeed. Without the priestess's actions, the war would have continued and the outnumbered drakes would have been crushed.
m920029.え……山賊？\nこんなところになぜ……。\nまわりは海だらけなのに。:
Huh… bandits?
Why here…
The whole area is just sea.
m920029.ええっ……！？\n魔物が人間に助けを求めるなんて……。: What…!? A monster begging humans for help…?
m920029.おいおい……あの炎の魔物がお宝だと……？\nあんなもん一銭にもなりゃしねぇじゃね:
Hey hey… that fiery monster's supposed to be treasure…?
That thing's not worth a damn!
Damn! Got fooled again…!
m920029.おいおい。なんだここは。\nあっついな！: Hey, hey. What the heck is this place? It's blazing hot!
m920029.おお巫女よ。\nわしはこの通り無事じゃ。: Ah, priestess. I'm fine, just as you see.
m920029.おお！あれは……！\nまさしく偉大なる炎の大精霊では！: Oh! That…! It's the great fire spirit itself!
m920029.お久しぶりです。\nあの時は大変お世話になりました。: It's been a while. Thank you for everything back then.
m920029.くそっ。なんだこのネバネバ野郎！\nどんどん出てきやがる……。\nしかも、宝は全:
Damn it. What the hell is this slime-y bastard!
It keeps popping up…
And we haven't found any treasure at all.
m920029.けど、今回無理に前線に立たせてもらって、\n新たな力を得る事ができました。\nこ:
But this time, being forced onto the front lines gave me new strength.
All thanks to you, Prince, and everyone else.
m920029.ここは……。\n道を間違ってしまったのでしょうか……。\n見た事もない場所です。: This place… Did we take a wrong turn? I've never seen it before.
m920029.ここはお宝の匂いがプンプンするぜ！: I can smell the treasure all over this place!
m920029.ここは灼熱の地です。\n兵の体力が奪われてしまいます。\nお気を付けください！: This is a scorching land. Our troops' stamina will drain fast. Please be careful!
m920029.この大穴は、まさか……！: This huge hole… could it be…!
m920029.これからは私も今回の旅で得た力を使って、\n王子、そして皆のサポートをさせていた: From now on, I'll use the power I gained on this trip to support you, Prince, and everyone.
m920029.これからも彼らが敵となる事が\nあるかもしれませんね……。\n王子、これからも充:
We may still run into them as enemies in the future…
Prince, let's stay on our guard.
m920029.これでもう大丈夫です。\n家に帰れますよ。: Now it's safe. You can return home.
m920029.こんな老兵でも、やれる事はある。\nまだ若いもんに負けるわけにはいかんじゃろ？: Even an old soldier like me still has something to offer. I can't let the younger ones have all the glory.
m920029.さっきのアイギス様の啓示はいったい。\n歴戦の地、答え……。\n女神様は確かにそ: What exactly was that revelation from Aegis just now? The battlefield of countless wars, the answer… The goddess did indeed say that.
m920029.さて、ここの宝はなくなってる事だし、\n別の場所に行こうかしら！: Well, the treasure here's gone, so shall we head somewhere else?
m920029.さて、王子。長居する理由もありませんし、\n参りましょう。: Well then, Prince. No reason to linger, let's be on our way.
m920029.しかし此度その別勢力が、軍隊を率いて\n勝手に地上への侵攻を開始しおったのじゃ。: And now that splinter group has taken an army and started a rogue invasion of the surface.
m920029.そうそう。\n新しいお宝の場所の噂聞いてるんだけど\n知りたい？: By the way, I've heard rumors about a new treasure location. Want to know?
m920029.そうだ、魔法の力がなくても\n継続的な癒しの力を使う方法が\n古い書物にのってい: That's right—there should be a method in the old tomes for using a steady healing power even without magic…
m920029.そうですね！\nこの方達はきっと悪い事はしないと思います。\n魔物にも争いを好ま: That's right! I'm sure these folks won't do anything bad. Even monsters can dislike fighting!
m920029.そして、燃える王都を背に、王子を説得し\n王城を脱出したあの日……。\n昨日のこ: And that day we persuaded you to flee the castle, with the burning capital behind us… it feels like it was just yesterday.
m920029.その力が王子と世界の未来の要の一つに\nなれるよう、期待しています。: I hope that power becomes one of the keys to the Prince's and the world's future.
m920029.それに、いい男と一緒に宝探しなんて\nそれって何かあるでしょ……？\n絶対に♪: Besides, treasure hunting with a handsome guy like you… there's gotta be something special about that, right? Absolutely! ♪
m920029.それに、太古の技術で作られたというあの人形の\n封印も解かれていたようでした。: And it seems the seal on that doll made with ancient technology was broken too.
m920029.それにしても、\n彼らの隠れ家がこんな所にあったなんて…。\n忍者達は諜報や謀略:
And to think their hideout was in a place like this…
Ninjas were supposed to excel at espionage and scheming.
m920029.それよりも共存し、お互いの種の繁栄を\n目指さねばならぬ時。: Instead, we must coexist and work toward the prosperity of both our peoples.
m920029.それを忘れてはなりません。\n必ずや彼らが力になる事でしょう。: Don't forget that. They'll surely become your strength.
m920029.そんなことが……。\nでしたら私たちも協力いたします。: That's... impossible. Then we'll lend our aid as well.
m920029.そんな事よりほんとにお宝あるんだろうな？: Anyway, there really is treasure here, right?
m920029.ですが、これまで仲間になってくれた方々と力を\n合わせればきっと勝利できます！: But if we join forces with everyone who's stood by us, we'll surely prevail!
m920029.とにかく彼らが住処を取り戻せて良かったです。\nそれでは、先を急ぎましょう。: Anyway, I'm glad they got their home back. Let's hurry onward.
m920029.なにか手は……。\n確か以前、宝剣の書物を目にしたような……。\n剣に魔法の力を: There must be a way… I recall a book about a sacred sword… It said you can imbue a blade with magical power.
m920029.なにやつ。\n見慣れぬ者だな。合言葉を答えよ！\n……山！: What the—? An unfamiliar face. Answer the password! …Mountain!
m920029.なんだか、騒々しいな。\nこれでは、全く修行にならない……。\n場所を変えるとし: This is getting too noisy. It's no good for training… We should find another spot.
m920029.なんだそれ……。\nわざわざ山を下りて、へんぴな\n海まで来たってのによ……。: What's that about… You came all the way down the mountain to this weird sea, and now you're complaining?
m920029.なんとか王子をサポートしなければ……！: I have to find a way to support you, Prince…!
m920029.はい。\nアイギス様のご啓示により、私は多くの事を\n学ばせていただきました。:
Yes.
Through your revelation, Dan, I've learned many things.
m920029.ふぅ。王子。\nやはりここはすごい熱気ですね。: Phew, Prince. This place is really hot.
m920029.ふう。\nそれにしても彼らの不規則な動きは\nやはり恐ろしいですね。:
Phew.
Still, their erratic movements are truly terrifying.
m920029.ふう。\nまたあの召喚獣と戦う事になるとは……。:
Phew.
So we have to fight that summoned beast again…
m920029.ふふ。\nあなたは興味ないものね。そういうの。\nやっぱりいい男！: Hehe. You're not interested, are you? That's just like you—what a fine man!
m920029.ふむ。やはりここ灼熱の洞窟は\n修行にぴったりだな。: Hm. As expected, this scorching cave is perfect for training.
m920029.ほう。そりゃすげぇな。\n昔っからお宝っていうのは、人が簡単には\n近づけねぇ所: Huh, impressive. Treasure's always been something you can't just stroll up to.
m920029.ま、王城に攻めてきたあの魔物の大群に\n比べりゃなんてことないぜ。: Compared to that massive monster horde that assaulted the royal castle, this is nothing.
m920029.まさか、魔物の中にあの様な方々がいたとは。\nいままでに出会った事がありません。: I never imagined such people among monsters. I've never met them before. Monsters feel the same pain of losing their homes as humans do.
m920029.やっとこの辺りの魔物はいなくなったみたいです。: Looks like the monsters around here are finally gone.
m920029.やはりこの洞窟は危険ですね。\nあまり近づかない方がいいのかもしれません。:
This cave is dangerous, after all.
We'd better keep our distance.
m920029.ようやくあやつらを説得できたか……。\nしかし、同族で刃を交える事は\nもうした: So at last we managed to persuade them... Yet I never want to clash with my own kind again.
m920029.ようやく倒せました。\nそれにしても、魔物が隊列を組んで襲ってくるなんて\n不思:
We finally took them down.
But still, it's weird how the monsters marched in formation to attack.
m920029.ようやく魔物がいなくなったようです。\nこれでゆっくり慰霊する事が出来ます。: It looks like the monsters are finally gone. Now we can finally pay our respects properly.
m920029.わしの工房の釜にもぴったり収まる！\nそのうち大きく育ってくれるに\n違いない！: It'll fit right into my workshop's furnace! It'll grow bigger in no time!
m920029.わしは何とかしてそれを止めねばならん。\nこれ以上は無益な争いにしかならぬ。: I have to put a stop to it somehow. Anything beyond this will only be pointless bloodshed.
m920029.わしも歳が歳じゃからのぅ。\n政治的な力が衰えたことにも起因しておろう。: I'm getting on in years, after all—my political influence has waned, too.
m920029.わしも歳をとったものじゃ。\n地下に閉じこもって旧知の同胞達といるばかりで、\n: I'm old now, holed up underground with old comrades, bound by the chains of fate.
m920029.わしらの宝は渡さんぞー！: We won't hand over our treasure!
m920029.わしら種族の数も減ってきている今、\nいがみ合うだけ無駄なのじゃ。: Our numbers are dwindling, so fighting each other is pointless.
m920029.わたしの力が弱まっている今。\n頼れるのは貴方達しかいません。:
My power is waning now.
You're all I can rely on.
m920029.わわーーーっ。 \n馬が暴走しちゃってる！\n誰か止めてください！:
Waaah—!
The horse's gone wild!
Someone stop it, please!
m920029.ん。なんか人影がいたような気がしたが……。\n気のせいか。こんな暑っ苦しい洞窟に: Huh. I thought I saw a shadow… maybe it's just my imagination. No one could be in a sweltering cave like this.
m920029.ん？ 暑いか？\nひ弱じゃのう。\nそれでも山賊なのか？: Huh? It's hot? You're weak, you know. And you're still a bandit?
m920029.アイギス様が何を伝えたかったのか、\nそれを見にいかなくては。: We have to go see what Aegis wanted to convey.
m920029.アウトローずっとやってきてて\n何今更そんな事言ってるのよ。: You've been an outlaw forever—why are you bringing that up now?

Ouj!
Here it comes. Here it comes.
m920029.ギャーー。\nお頭助けてー。\nネバネバで動けねぇー。:
Gyaa!
Help me, boss!
We can't move because of the slime!
m920029.ソウスル。オレイ。イツカ。\nゴチソウ。ゴチソウ。: Will do. One day… Thank you. Thank you.

m920029.ニンゲンニワルイコトシナイ。: We have no ill will toward humans.
m920029.ヒーラーの方々の様に一度に大きく回復する事は\n出来ないのですが、その分出来る限: I can't heal you all at once like the healers do, but I'll stay by your side and support you as best I can!
m920029.一体どうなってんだ。\nお前らそっちはどうだ？:
What's going on here?
How are you guys doing over there?
m920029.一族が長年探し求めるものなのじゃ！\n素晴らしいものに違いないぞ。: It's been what our people have been searching for for ages! It must be something magnificent.
m920029.一族には古い文献が数多く残っておる。\nその中に「大いなる力」なるものの\n記述: Our clan has many ancient texts. One of them mentions something called “the Great Power.”
m920029.世界を平和へと導きましょう！: Let's lead the world toward peace!
m920029.人の子よ……。\n思い悩んでいるようですね。: Child of man… You seem troubled.
m920029.人の子よ……。\n迷いは晴れたようですね。:
Child of man…
Your doubts seem cleared.
m920029.人間を忌み嫌っておられた頃とは\n随分変わられました。\n私、嬉しいです……っ。: You've changed so much since you despised humans. I'm happy...
m920029.今では竜人を二分する勢力争いにまで発展し、\nあやつらは別勢力を作りおった。: These days the drake factions have split into two sides, and they've each formed their own camps.
m920029.今のこの世は混沌でしかありません。\n魔物達の秩序もなくなっています。: This world is nothing but chaos now. Even the monsters have lost any sense of order.
m920029.今わしはあやつらを止めていたところじゃ。: I was just stopping them a moment ago.
m920029.今回のアイギス様の啓示にも、\nきっと何か意味があると思うんです。: I'm sure there's meaning behind this latest revelation from Aegis.
m920029.今回の旅、最初は魔物を前に\nなにもする事が出来なかった。: At the start of this journey, I couldn't do anything when faced with monsters.
m920029.今回は王子にいつもより多くの\n敵に立ち向かえる様、力を付与しております！: This time I've granted you extra strength so you can face even more foes than usual!
m920029.今回も王子の鎧に力を付与いたしました！\nこれで、彼女達の宝剣の力に少しでも\n: I've once again empowered your armor, Prince! Hopefully it'll help you stand against their sacred swords…
m920029.今度の所は毒が立ち込めてて\n一人じゃ行けそうもないんだもの。: The next place is swarming with poison; I can't go alone.
m920029.何ブツブツ言ってるの？\nあなた達まがりなりにも山賊でしょ？: What are you muttering about? You're bandits, after all.
m920029.例え魔物でも、平和を望む方たちならば\n私は治癒士としての仕事を全うします！: Even if they're monsters, if they seek peace, I'll fulfill my duties as a healer!
m920029.全ては己の選択、ですか……。: So everything comes down to one's own choices…?
m920029.千年戦争からわしらは敵として刃を交えておった。\nしかしそれはもう過去の話……。: Since the Millennium War, we've clashed as enemies. But that's all in the past now.
m920029.大長老様っ、ご無事ですか！？: Grand Elder! Are you all right?!
m920029.少し様子を見て御采配いただいた方が\n良さそうです！: It might be best to observe a bit and let you decide the tactics!
m920029.山賊たちのせいで、魔物もこっちに来てるな。\n奴らには人間の区別なんてつかないか:
Because of the bandits, the monsters are also coming this way.
They don't discriminate.
m920029.平和だった私たちの安住の地が\n魔物たちに蹂躙されたあの日から、\n今日で丁度一: It's been exactly one year since that day when our peaceful homeland was ravaged by monsters.
m920029.彼らの事を思うと胸がはりさけそうです……。\n王子、今日は彼らの魂を弔いましょう: Thinking of them makes my chest feel like it will burst… Prince, let's honor their souls today.
m920029.彼らは本来、主につかえ、\n私たちと同じで魔物を倒し\n世界を護る事を役割として: They're meant to serve their lords, just like us—slaying monsters and protecting the world…
m920029.微力ですが、王子のお力になり、\n世界を平和に導くよう、これからも\nがんばって: Though I'm small, I'll keep helping the Prince, and work toward peace for the world.
m920029.忍者たちとのこれまでの闘いの経験が\nなければ、今頃……。: If we hadn't had any experience fighting ninjas before, we'd be… now.
m920029.思えばこれまでの旅路、\nあっという間でしたけど\n沢山の事が起きましたね。: Thinking back on our journey so far, it's passed in the blink of an eye, yet so much has happened.
m920029.情報を信じるも信じないも\n自己責任だわよ。: Whether you trust the info or not is on your own responsibility.
m920029.政務官としての役割から逸脱した、\n私の自分勝手なお願いを聞いていただき\nあり: Thank you for hearing my selfish request, which strays from my duties as a civil servant.
m920029.敵襲！ 敵襲！\n魔物達が隊列を組んで進んできます！:
Enemy attack! Enemy attack!
The monsters are forming a formation and advancing!
m920029.歴戦の地に向いなさい。\nそこに答えがあるでしょう。: Head to the battlefield. The answer lies there.
m920029.王城に現れたおぞましい魔物の大群……。\nなすすべもなく殺されていった\n兵たち: The hordes of hideous monsters that appeared at the royal castle… the soldiers who were slaughtered helplessly…
m920029.王子……！\n今回は王子の剣に宝剣の力を付与しております。\nこれで彼らの厚い鱗: Prince…! I've now infused your sword with the sacred blade's power. It should let you cut through their hard scales!
m920029.王子……！ 山賊たちです！\n一体なんなんでしょうか！？\nこちらに向かってきま: Prince…! Bandits! What on earth are they doing? They're coming right at us!
m920029.王子、お気を付けください！\nやはり私たちを敵とみなしているようです。\nこちら: Prince, watch out! They're treating us as enemies and heading straight for us!
m920029.王子、これからもっと厳しい戦いになるでしょう。: Prince, the battles ahead will only get tougher.
m920029.王子、それでは戻りましょうか。: Prince, shall we head back then?
m920029.王子、今回は少しずつですが、\n王子の体力を回復し続けます！: Prince, this time I'll slowly but surely keep restoring your stamina!
m920029.王子、今回は私も前線に立たせてください。: Prince, please let me stand on the front lines this time as well.
m920029.王子、今回も癒しの力でお助けいたします！: Prince, I'll aid you again with my healing power!
m920029.王子、今日は何の日かご存じですか？: Prince, do you know what day it is today?
m920029.王子、彼らの住処、取り戻すのを\nお手伝いしましょう。: Prince, let's help them reclaim their home.
m920029.王子、彼ら忍者は卑劣にも、\n遠巻きに手裏剣を投げる戦法を得意としています。\n:
Prince, those ninjas are despicably good at tossing shuriken from afar.
We might get taken down in a flash…
m920029.王子、彼ら竜人は鱗が厚く、並大抵の\n剣ではその刃を通すことが出来ません……。: Prince, those drakes have thick scales; a regular sword can't pierce them…
m920029.王子、潮風が心地いいですね。\nここでも色んな事がありましたよね。:
Prince, the sea breeze feels wonderful.
We've had all sorts of things happen here, haven't we?
m920029.王子、話が通じないようです！\n向かってきます！:
Prince, we can't get through!
They're heading our way!
m920029.王子よ、世話になったな。\nわしも種族をまとめられるように、\n生きてる限り手を: Prince, you've been a great help. I'll do everything I can, as long as I live, to unite our peoples.
m920029.男気だせ！\nあの海賊の情報はぜってぇ確かだからな！:
Show some manhood!
That pirate intel is rock-solid!
m920029.確か緑の魔物には、\n魔法の威力が半減していたはず……。\n王子、お気を付けくだ:
I'm pretty sure green monsters halve the power of magic…
Prince, please be careful!
m920029.私、あの時追ってきた魔物の足音が\n耳にまだ残ってます……。\n王子を出口までお: I can still hear the footsteps of the monsters I chased that time… All I could do was escort you to the exit…
m920029.竜人と人間、今度は互いに手を取り合う番です。\n共存できる世界になるよう、頑張り: It's time for dragons and humans to finally join hands. Let's work together to create a world where we can coexist!
m920029.竜人の国を飛び出して追われていた\n私を助けてくれましたよね……。: You rescued me when I fled the drake nation and was being hunted...
m920029.良かったです！\n大長老様がこの様に身をていして\n争いを阻止してくださるなんて: That's a relief! To think the Grand Elder would risk himself like this to stop the fighting...
m920029.英雄の末裔よ……。\n魔の力はまだまだ強大です。:
Descendant of heroes…
The demonic power is still overwhelmingly strong.
m920029.英雄の血を引く王子ならば、\nきっと世界を平和にしてくれる。\n私たちは今そう思: If the Prince, who bears the blood of heroes, leads us, he'll surely bring peace. That's what we believe.
m920029.迫る魔物の大群……圧倒的な絶望を前に、\nそれでも英雄の血を\n絶やすまいと命を: The overwhelming swarm of monsters… in the face of crushing despair, the soldiers who threw their lives away so that the hero's blood wouldn't be extinguished…
m920029.進むも進まざるも全ては己の選択です。\nですが、あなたならきっと……。: Whether you move forward or not, it's all your choice. But I know you can…
m920029.鍛冶の神が伝説の武具を創られる際に\n使ったとされるものじゃ！: It's said to be what the forge god used when crafting legendary weapons!
m920029.隊列……？\n王子、お気を付けください。\n魔物の動きがいつもと違うようです。:
Formation…?
Prince, stay alert.
Their movements seem different this time.
m920029.頼む。\nお主ら人間とわしら竜人は\n共存の道を歩むべきなのじゃ。: Please. Humans and drakes alike must walk the path of coexistence.
m920029.魔物から平和を勝ち取るには、\n英雄の末裔たるあなたの力が必要不可欠。: To win peace from the monsters, we'll need the power of you, the hero's descendant.
m920029.魔物がはびこっている今の世では、\n主を魔物に殺された忍者達が\n仕方なく魔物に: In these monster-infested times, some ninjas whose lords were slain by monsters end up—reluctantly—working with them.

m920029.（こんな私では兵達に顔向けできない）: (I can't even face the soldiers like this.)

m920029.（兵達への弔いだったのに……。\n 私はなんて無力なんだろう）: (It was supposed to be a tribute to the soldiers… I'm so powerless.)

m920057.……というわけなので、なんとかよろしく\nお願いします王子さま。: So, please, Prince, do something about this.
m920057.……もうよい。今日は疲れた。\n今回の作戦は終わりだ。: ...That's enough. I'm tired today. This operation is over.
m920057.……やけに協力的じゃないか。\n何を企んでる……？: …You're being unusually cooperative. What are you plotting?
m920057.……最後に『約束したからには、\n本気で戦わせてもらうわ。覚悟してねぇ』\nとの: He finished with, “Since I made a promise, I'll fight you seriously. Be prepared.”
m920057.……行ってしまいました。\n時間がないといっていましたが、\nなにか急いでいるの: …She's gone. She said there's no time, so she must be in a hurry.
m920057.……諦めるわけにはいかないわ。\n次の作戦を考えてみるから、\nちょっと待って。: ...I can't just give up. I'll think of a new plan, so just hold on a moment.
m920057.あ、あらそう……。\nそれならいいのよ。\nちゃんと約束通り、全部見つけておいて: Oh, I see… In that case, that's fine. Make sure you find everything as promised.
m920057.あたしのプレゼントを待っている\nたくさんの子供たちのために……: For the many children waiting for my present…
m920057.あたしは寒いのは平気だからいいけどさ。: I'm fine with the cold, so it's no problem for me.
m920057.あっ、あたし急いでるんだった！\nごめんなさい、\nまた今度ゆっくり会いましょう: Ah, I'm in a rush! Sorry—let's meet up again later when we have time.
m920057.あなたは卑怯でどうしようもない人間だわ。\n……っていうか、人間かすら怪しいけど: You're a cowardly, hopeless human… Actually, I'm not even sure you're even human at all.
m920057.あはは、じゃあね。\n次に会う時は敵同士かもしれないけれど。\nその時は手加減し: Heh, see you later. We might be enemies next time we meet… and I won't hold back.
m920057.いずれ世界は闇に包まれる。\n光では世界は救えぬ、本当に世界を救いたくば、\n闇: Eventually, darkness will engulf everything. Light can't save the world—if you truly want to save it, you'll have to seize the power of darkness.
m920057.いやー、まさか最後の一つがあんな場所に……。\nなんで貴様はあんなところに落とす: Whoa, I never expected the last one to be in that place… Why would you drop it there?
m920057.うむ。\n我輩はちゃんと奥の手を準備しておいたのだ。: Yes. I've got a proper trump card ready for them.
m920057.うるさいのがいなくなったか。\n貴様たちが、どんなにがんばっても\nすでに世界の: So the noisy ones are finally gone. No matter how hard you all try, the world's fate is already sealed.
m920057.うるさい！\nまだお前が落としたものが全部見つからんのだ。\n手分けして探してい: Quiet! I still haven't found everything you dropped. We're searching in teams, so hold on.
m920057.うーん、暗黒騎士団は機動力が乏しいのよねぇ。\n騎兵はいるけど、飛び道具がノロい: Hmm, the Dark Knights are so sluggish. We have cavalry, but our ranged attacks are painfully slow. Oh, I've got a good idea!
m920057.うーん。困ったわね。\nあたし、あんまり美味しくないと思うけどなぁ……。: Hmm, that's a problem. I don't think I'm very tasty, though…
m920057.う～ん。負けちゃったわね。\n作戦は良かったと思うんだけど、\nあたしの力が足り: Huh… we lost. The plan was solid, but my strength wasn't enough… I'm sorry.
m920057.え、ちょっと待ちなさいよ。\nもしかして嘘ついてるの！？: Wait, hold on. Are you lying to me?!
m920057.えっ、本当に？ いいの？\n良かった～。\n早速プレゼントを詰め込まなきゃ！: Really? That's okay? Great! I have to start packing the presents right away!
m920057.えっと……。\nあんたは……。\n人間……、なわけないわよねぇ……。: Um… you're… you're not human, are you?
m920057.おかげで子供たちにプレゼントが\n配れるわけだし。結果的にあんたが\nしたことで: Thanks to you, the kids get their gifts. In the end, because of what you did, they'll be happy.
m920057.お前、我輩との約束を信じているのか？: Do you really trust the promise you made with me?
m920057.ぐぬぅ。仕方ない……。\n暗黒騎士たちよ、\n少しだけ王子の足止めをしておくのだ: Hmph. Fine... Dark Knights, hold the Prince off for a little while.
m920057.この雪山ってあたしよく来るんだけど、\n結構強い吹雪がくるのよね。大丈夫なの？: I come to these snowy mountains a lot, but the blizzards can get pretty fierce. You all okay?
m920057.こんなところにいたか。\nやったぞ、お前が落としたものを全部見つけたぞ！: There you are. Gotcha—I found everything you dropped!
m920057.こんな場所までおびき寄せ、\n罠を張っても倒せぬとは。\nもはやここまでか……。: To think I'd lure you all the way out here, set a trap, and still be unable to defeat you... Is this how it ends?
m920057.さ、次の場所に行こっと。: Let's head to the next spot.
m920057.さすがに強いわね。\nあたしも少しは腕に自信があったのに\nお姉さん、ちょっとシ: You're really strong. I thought I had some skill, but… sister, I'm a bit shocked…
m920057.さて、本題ですがあの人からの伝言を\nお伝えします。: Now, getting to the point, I have a message from that person to deliver.
m920057.じゃあ団長さん、あたしはもう行くね。\nみんながプレゼントを待ってるだろうから。: Well then, Commander, I'm off. Everyone's waiting for their presents.
m920057.そうだな。\n我輩が王子たちを引き付けておくから、\nお前はもう一方から攻めてく: Right. I'll keep the Prince occupied, and you attack from the other side.
m920057.そうねぇ。\n王子がこんなに手強いとは思わなかったわ。\nそろそろあたし達も攻め: Yeah. I never expected the Prince to be this tough. We should start pressing the attack soon.
m920057.そうねぇ。やっぱり日々、\n筋肉を鍛えておく事かしらね。\n弦を引く力が強くない: Well… you've got to keep training your muscles every day. If you can't pull the string strong enough, it's no use.
m920057.そして、そのプレゼントを拾ったのが、\n暗黒騎士団だったらしく……。: And it seems the Dark Knights picked up those presents…
m920057.その事で、彼女から伝言を預かって\nきています。: About that, I have a message from her.
m920057.その団長からプレゼントを返して\n欲しかったら、王子を倒すのを手伝うよう\n約束: Their leader said that if we want the presents back, we have to help him defeat you, the Prince, as promised.
m920057.その間に、我輩がやつらを手なずけておく。: In the meantime, I'll go tame those creatures.

Come on, Koma-chan! Get 'em!
A nice Komainu Punch to knock her out!
m920171.さあ構えろ、誇り高き王国の戦士たちよ。\nクラールフ様の手前、無様な姿も見せられ:
Now then, take your positions, proud warriors of the Kingdom.
For Lord Klaarf's sake, we cannot afford to look foolish.
I shall challenge you with the full might of my people.
m920171.さて……事故か事件か。\n一般人の安全を確保次第、\n本格的な調査を始めましょう:
Well… whether it's an accident or a crime.
Once we've secured the safety of the civilians,
let's begin a full-scale investigation.
m920171.しかし、彼女らには今しばらくの間、\n純粋に温泉を楽しんでもらいましょうか。:
Still, I think we should let them enjoy the hot springs
in peace for a little while longer.
m920171.すまぬがフィーヌ嬢、それはできん。\nもしここでそちらが引いてくれるのであれば、:
I'm sorry, Miss Fine, but I cannot.
If you will withdraw now, I promise we will cause no further damage to the hot spring town.
m920171.ぜーはーっ！ ぜーはーっ！\nなっ、なんだったんですか今の……！？:
P-Phew…! P-Phew…!
W-What was all that about…!?
m920171.そういうこと、観念しなさい。\nさあ帰るわよヨシノ、チヨメもね。:
Accept your fate.
Come on, Yoshino. Chiyome, too. We're going home.
m920171.そうだ！ 深海のみなさんも一緒に、\nこれから温泉でお疲れ様会しませんか！？:
That's it! Why don't we all go to a hot spring together,
including everyone from the deep sea, to celebrate the end of our hard work?
m920171.そして、ここにいる我らも本物だ。\n悪いが私にも譲れないものがあってね。\nそれ:
And the ones here are the real deal, too.
I'm sorry, but there are things I can't give up.
That final promise I made to my late friend.
m920171.そっ、それでは早速──熱っっっっづ！？: T-Then, let's just dive right in— H-HOT?!
m920171.その上で、人々を守るのが私の使命。\n全力で、あなたを止めさせてもらいます！:
That said, protecting people is my duty.
I'll do everything I can to stop you!
m920171.その件については宿の者らと話すべきでしょう。\n我らとしては、王子に罰する気がな:
We should speak with the innkeepers about that matter.
As for us, we have no objections if the Prince does not wish to punish you.
m920171.そもそもフジムラサキは私の刀じゃん。\nなんで普通に裏切ってシズカの方にいたの。:
Besides, Fujimurasaki is *my* sword.
Why were you just standing on Shizuka's side like it was normal?
m920171.それが、我が子を救ってほしい……と？: She wanted us to save her child……?
m920171.それで、温泉を貸し切ったんですね。\nドラコシーサウルスの体温に、\nもっとも近:
So you rented out the hot spring.
To create an environment closest to the Draco Sea Sauruses' body temperature.
m920171.それではみなさん！\n少しの休憩を挟みまして、\n演習を続けて行きましょー！:
Now then, everyone!
After a short break,
let's continue the exercise!
--- scene: First Hot Spring Trip (battle, start) ---
m920171.それならそれで好都合です、\n私たちは黒幕の捜索に戻りましょう。:
Well, that's convenient.
Let's return to searching for the mastermind.
m920171.それも死体の傷口を見るに、\n同族に殺された可能性が高いと。:
Judging by the wounds on the bodies,
it's highly likely they were killed by their own kind.
m920171.そんな貴女にチヨメさんが颯爽登場！: Chiyome is here to save the day, just for you!
m920171.だが、世界の命運を懸けた戦いを前に、\nこれ以上海の中で傍観するだけなど御免だ。:
But with the fate of the world hanging in the balance,
I refuse to merely watch from the water any longer.
We must prove that we can fight on land, too.
m920171.だが、孵化の中断は無理な相談だ。\nそういう契約でね、それにほら──:
However, interrupting the hatching is out of the question.
That's the nature of the contract, and besides, look──
m920171.ちょ、ちょっと待ってください！！\nあなたが黒幕ではないのですか！？:
W-wait a moment!!
Aren't you the mastermind behind all this!?
m920171.つまり誰かのペットってこと？\n何の目的で温泉にあんな魔物を！:
So it's someone's pet?
What on earth is the point of releasing monsters into the hot springs!
m920171.でっ、では！ 僭越ながら私が！\n深海を代表して視察して参ります！:
T-Then! I humbly volunteer!
I will go inspect it on behalf of the deep sea!
m920171.でっかいのがこっちに向かってくるわよ！？: A big one's heading our way!
m920171.ではさらばだ、王子諸君。\n賠償金については雇用主に請求してくれたまえ。\n間違:
Farewell, Prince and company.
Please direct any compensation claims to the employer.
Do not send them to me, under any circumstances.
m920171.ではその雇用主とは誰なんですか！？\n私の！ 温泉旅行を！ 台無しにした犯人は！:
Then who is that employer!?
The one who ruined my! Hot spring trip!
m920171.なっ！ あいついくら払ったと──しまった！？: Wh- How much did they pay that creature, I w-wait!
m920171.はあ……やっぱり温泉は気持ち良いですねぇ。: Ahh… Hot springs really are the best.
m920171.ははぁ、ありがたき幸せ。\nそれでお姫様、お代の方は──:
Haha, your kindness is appreciated.
Now then, Princess, about the payment—
m920171.ははは、あれは純王国産高級牛肉を使った、\n正真正銘本物のステーキだともフィーヌ:
Hahaha, Miss Fine, that was a genuine steak
made with premium Pure Kingdom beef!
m920171.ひゅー！ うちのお姫様は最高だぜぇ！\nコマちゃん！ 今日のご飯は大盛ですよ！:
Whoo! Our Princess is the best!
Koma! Make it a big portion for dinner today!
m920171.ふふっ……フィーヌさんもようやく、\n温泉を楽しめているようでなによりです。:
Pfft… I'm glad you're finally
enjoying the hot springs, Fine.
m920171.ふふっ、お互い良い刺激になっているみたいですね。: Hehe, it seems we're all inspiring one another.
m920171.ふふっ、どうやら決まりのようですね。\nそれでは温泉旅行の計画を立てましょう。:
Hehe, it seems it's settled, then.
Well then, let's start planning our hot spring trip.
m920171.ふわわぁ……体がポッカポカですぅ……。\nあとは温泉にでも入れたら最高なんですが:
Fwaaah... my body is all warm and cozy...
It would be perfect if we could soak in a hot spring next.
m920171.ほう、気合が入っているじゃないか。\nであれば、こちらも全力で迎え撃とう。:
Hm, you certainly have some spirit.
In that case, we shall meet your challenge with everything we have.
m920171.ほわぁぁぁっ！ 温泉卵おいしいですぅぅぅっ！？: Mmm~! These hot spring eggs are so delicious~!
m920171.まあこちらも地上での戦いで、\n魚人に負けては立つ瀬がないからな。\nだが、凄ま:
Well, we couldn't afford to lose to the fish-folk in a land battle.
But I could feel a tremendous intensity coming from them.
m920171.まさかコウメちゃんの実家に、\nこんな秘湯が隠されてたなんてね。\nいやぁ、持つ:
I never imagined Koume's family home
hid such a secret spring.
Well, it pays to have a talented commoner.
m920171.まさかコマちゃんの縄張りを荒らしておいて、\nただで帰れるなんて思っちゃってるの:
You trampled all over Koma-chan's turf,
and you actually think you can just walk away?
m920171.まさかデーモンシェフさんが犯人だったなんて……。: I never would have guessed the Demon Chef was the culprit…
m920171.まさに孵化しようという頃合いだ。\n今更止められるようなものではないよ。:
The moment of hatching is nigh.
It's far too late to stop them now.
m920171.ますます怪しいわね……って、\nみんな！ あそこに誰かいるわよ！:
It's getting more and more suspicious… Wait,
everyone! There's someone over there!
m920171.まだ調べていない場所と言えば、\nこの貸し切りになっている宿ですが……。:
The only place we haven't checked yet is
this inn that's been rented out exclusively…
m920171.みなさん、素晴らしい向上心ですねぇ……\nうちのお姫さんにも見習ってほしいぐらい:
Everyone, what wonderful drive you all have…
I wish my princess would take a page from your book.
m920171.みなさん注意してください！\nドラコシーサウルスは水中を移動できます！\n奇襲に:
Everyone, be careful!
The Draco Seisaurs can move underwater!
Watch your positions so you don't get ambushed!
m920171.むぅ、見つかったからには仕方ありません。\nですが、コマちゃんがそれを許すでしょ:
Hmph. Now that we've been found, there's no choice.
But will Koma-chan allow that?
m920171.やはりそう簡単には行かぬか……。: So it wasn't going to be that easy, was it…
m920171.ゆえに我らには契約を遂行する義務がある。\nたとえそれが、正しくない行いだったと:
That is why we are bound to fulfill our contract.
Even if it means doing the wrong thing.
We cannot abandon the orphan of our friend.
m920171.よくぞやってくれた、社員諸君。\nこれでやっと、我が友との約束を守れる。:
Well done, my employees.
Now, at last, I can keep my promise to my friend.
m920171.よくも……よくも私の初めての温泉旅行をー！！: How dare you… how dare you ruin my first hot spring trip—!!
m920171.よーし、ヨシノお姉さん。\nこの村の年貢免除しちゃうぞー。:
Alright, Sister Yoshino
is waiving this village's taxes!
m920171.わあ！ すっごく楽しそうです！\n行ってもよいですか、クラールフ様！:
Oh! That sounds so much fun!
May we go, Lord Klaarf?
m920171.わわっ、あすもちゃん！？ \n私なら全然大丈夫ですから！:
W-Waa, Asmo-chan?!
I'm perfectly fine, so please don't worry!
m920171.んー、まあ温泉は入ったし。\nそろそろ帰って仕事するかー。:
Well, I did get to soak in the spring.
Time to head back and get to work, I guess.
m920171.エマさんの勘が大当たりみたいですね。\n世界各地の漁村で魔物の死体の発見報告が、:
It seems your instincts were right on the mark.
Reports of monster carcasses washing up in fishing villages
around the world have been increasing rapidly lately.
m920171.オーベッド……ああ、そうだ、その通りだ。\n魚人の誇りに懸け、このままでは終わら:
Obed… Ah, yes, you are right.
I swear on the pride of my people, this is not the end.
m920171.グレーターデーモンは全て喋りましたよ？: The Greater Demon told us everything, didn't it?
m920171.グレーターデーモン！？\nあなたがドラコリザードを、\n温泉街に放った黒幕なので:
A Greater Demon!?
You're the one who released the Draco Lizards
into the hot spring town, aren't you!!
m920171.コマちゃんが困ってるでしょうが！！: Koma-chan looks like she's in trouble!!
m920171.シェフ逃げてください！ ここは私が！: Chef, run! I'll hold them off!
m920171.シェフ！ ドラコシーサウルス、\n孵化の準備段階にまで入りました！:
Chef! The Draco Cisauros
has entered the final stage of hatching!
m920171.ダメです！ 煮魚になってしまいます！: I'm done for! I'm going to turn into a boiled fish!
m920171.チヨメさんはお姫さんと違って、\nちゃんと休暇を申請してるのでー。:
Unlike the Princess,
I properly filed a vacation request, you see.
m920171.デモシェフ商会の福利厚生の一環として、\n社員一同で温泉旅行に来ているのですが…:
We're on a company hot spring trip, as part of the Demon Chef Trading Company's employee benefits program…
But you seem quite flustered. What's the matter?
m920171.デーモンシェフさんは、\n商会の内部留保が全部消えたって、\n寂しそうに呟いてま:
The Demon Chef said that
the company's entire reserve fund was gone,
and he looked rather lonely as he muttered it…
m920171.デーモンシェフさん！\nあなたは本当に裏切ったのですか！\n裏では私たちを笑って:
Demon Chef!
Did you really betray us?
Were you laughing at us behind our backs all along?
m920171.デーモンシェフさん！\nもうこんなことはやめてください！:
Demon Chef!
Please stop this madness!
m920171.ドラコリザードを外に逃がした挙句、\n王子を呼び寄せておきながら逃走とは。: He let the Draco Lizard escape, and after luring the Prince here, he just ran off.
m920171.フィーヌさん、もはや言葉は不要でしょう。\n皆さん戦闘準備を、ここで彼らを止めま:
Fine, words are unnecessary now.
Everyone, get ready for battle. We stop them here.
m920171.フィーヌさーん！ 入らないんですかー！？: Fine-san! Are you not going to get in?!
m920171.フィーヌさーん！ 温泉卵作りませんかー！: Fine-san~! Want to make hot spring eggs~?
m920171.ワシは業務を委託されただけで、\n今回ばかりはただの雇われ悪魔だよ。\nドラコリ:
I was merely commissioned for the work.
In this case, I'm just a hired demon.
Hatching the Draco Lizards was the employer's wish.
m920171.他のお客さんが襲われたら大変ですもんね、\n私が番台さんに報告して避難誘導してき:
It would be terrible if the other guests got attacked,
so I'll report to the front desk and guide everyone to safety!
m920171.他の宿の方に聞き込みしたところ、\n経営者一家は現在遠方に旅行中だとか。\nかな:
I asked the other inns, and it seems the owner's family
is currently traveling far away.
They appear to have rented out the entire inn for a considerable sum.
m920171.何か隠された事情があるはずです。\nそれを聞き出すためにも、彼らを止めなくては。:
There must be some hidden reason.
We need to stop them to find out what it is.
m920171.何と戦ってるのよ……。: What are you two even fighting about...
m920171.副デーモンシェフさん！？\nそちらこそどうしてここに！？:
Deputy Demon Chef!?
What are you doing here, of all places!?
m920171.双方準備はよろしいですね！\nそれではいざ！ 開戦でーす！:
Are both sides ready?
Then let's do this! Battle, begin!
--- scene: Midwinter Land-and-Sea Joint Exercise (battle, end) ---
m920171.周りにあるのは卵……ですね。\n温泉の熱で孵化させるつもりでしょうか。\n即刻、:
Those are eggs… aren't they?
Are you trying to hatch them using the heat of the springs?
I demand you cease this dangerous activity immediately.
m920171.変ですね……従業員の方もいません。: That's strange… there's no staff around either.
m920171.天界との戦いを控える中で、\n今度は海にも新たな異常の兆しとは。\n国へ帰還した:
With the war against the Celestial Realm looming, this is the latest sign of trouble in the sea.
Things are going to be hectic once we get back to the kingdom…
m920171.守秘義務の関係上、言えないね。\nなに、これだけの騒ぎを起こしたんだ、\nすぐに:
I'm bound by confidentiality, so I can't say.
But given the commotion, they'll find out soon enough.
m920171.尻尾を出しましたね。\nリズリーさん、お願いします。:
There's a tail sticking out.
Risley, please.
m920171.当館での行き過ぎた乱暴狼藉。\nいくら領主さまとて許せませぬ。\n恐れながら出禁:
The excessive violence and disorder in my establishment...
Even if you are the Lord, I cannot allow it.
I'm afraid I must ban you from the premises.
m920171.彼らは海の暴れん坊。深海の民として、\nそのようなものを街中で孵化させようとする:
They are the rascals of the sea. As a people of the deep,
we cannot stand by while you attempt to hatch such a creature
in the middle of town!
m920171.後悔は全部が終わってからよ。\nドラコシーサウルスが何か知らないけど、\n危ない:
Save your regrets for when this is all over.
I don't know what a Draco Cisauros is,
but if it's a dangerous monster, we have to stop it here.
m920171.恩に着るぞ、王子よ。そして子どもたちの\n命を奪わずにいてくれたこと、深く感謝す: I am grateful, Prince. And I deeply thank you for sparing the children's lives.
m920171.我らは、この卵を母親から託された。\n今際の際に、どうか我が子を救ってくれと。:
We were entrusted with this egg by its mother.
On her deathbed, she begged us to save her child.
m920171.戦闘終了……だけど、\n肝心のデーモンシェフたちには、\nどさくさで逃げられちゃ:
Battle over… but in the confusion,
the Demon Chefs managed to slip away.
m920171.推理は後です、まずはフィーヌさんの救出を。\nドラコリザードは水上を走ることがで:
We can deduce later. First, we need to rescue Fine-san.
Draco Lizards can run across the water's surface, so
be mindful of the terrain and your distance while fighting.
m920171.本合同演習の趣旨は、\n今後さらなる激化が予想される戦いに備え、\n各陣営の苦手:
The purpose of this joint exercise is to prepare for the battles
that are expected to intensify further in the future,
by overcoming the weaknesses of each camp.
m920171.本来は凶暴な魔物だが彼女は温厚な性格でな、\n人間とも上手に折り合いつけて共存し:
By nature, they are fierce monsters, but she had a gentle disposition.
It seems she managed to coexist peacefully with humans.
Then, the other day, she was found collapsed on the beach.
m920171.気づいたときには、もう手遅れだった。\n瀕死の状態でありながら大事に卵を抱えて、:
By the time we realized what had happened, it was already too late.
She was on the verge of death, yet she clutched her egg protectively.
As we rushed to her side, she pleaded with us through her eyes.
m920171.海だから動けない、陸だから戦えない。\nそんな言い訳も戦場には通用しません。:
"We can't move because it's the sea," or "We can't fight because it's land."
Such excuses will not be tolerated on the battlefield.
m920171.海底にも熱水の湧く場所があるだろう。\n乾いた地の民はあの熱い水を一か所に溜めて:
There are places where hot water springs up on the ocean floor.
I hear the people of the Dry Lands collect that hot water in one place
and build entertainment facilities called "hot springs" to heal their body and mind.
m920171.温泉街に魔物の卵を持ち込んだ犯人。\nグレーターデーモンはすぐに会えるって\n言:
The culprit who brought the monster's egg to the hot spring town.
The Greater Demon said we'd meet it soon,
but where on earth is it?
m920171.然り。同胞よ、敗北を嘆く必要はない。\nこれを糧として、次に活かせば良いだけの話:
Indeed. My kin, there is no need to mourn this defeat.
We simply use it as fuel for our next battle.
The day when we can lend our strength to the dry land is surely coming.
m920171.王国軍よ、フィーヌはああ言っているが、\n海中でも十分に戦えている貴殿らに比べて:
Army of the Kingdom, Fine says that, but
compared to you all, who can fight just fine in the sea,
we are unable to perform at our best outside of the water.
m920171.現状では何とも言えませんが、\nあれだけの数です、まだ他に隠れているやも。\n今:
It's hard to say for certain right now, but
given that number, there may be more hiding around.
We should evacuate the guests in the hot spring town immediately.
m920171.申し訳ありませんシェフ、\nあまり時間を稼ぐことができず……。:
I apologize, Chef.
I couldn't hold them off for very long…
m920171.疲れを癒しに来たはずが、\n余計に疲れている気がします……。:
I came here to relax,
but I feel even more exhausted than before…
m920171.皆、此度の演習ご苦労であった。\n乾いた地の民よ、協力に深く感謝しよう。\n実に:
Well done, everyone. You have worked hard on this exercise.
To the people of the Dry Lands, my deepest thanks for your cooperation.
I am confident this was a truly productive session.
m920171.皆さんドラコリザードの卵には注意を。\n衝撃を与えればそれだけ孵化も早まります、:
Everyone, be careful with the Draco Lizard eggs.
Shocking them only hastens the hatching.
If they all hatch at once, it will be difficult to repel them.
m920171.私が教えたの、残念だったわねお姫様。: I told her. How unfortunate for you, Princess.
m920171.私の人選ミスです。\n火急の案件だったとはいえ、\nもっと他の者を雇うべきでした:
It was my mistake in hiring.
Even if it was an urgent matter, I should have hired someone else.
m920171.私も想定以上に迫られたから、\n焦って何発か砲弾を外しちゃったわ。\n気を引き締:
I was pushed harder than I expected, too.
I got flustered and missed a few shots with my cannon.
I really need to tighten up my focus.
m920171.色々と大変だったものね。\nまあ辛うじて人的被害はなかったようだし、\n温泉街が:
It's been quite a ordeal.
Fortunately, there were no casualties,
and the hot spring town was able to reopen right away.
m920171.裏切られた、という気持ちはあるでしょう。\nしかし彼は、極めて理性的なデーモンで:
You must feel betrayed.
But he is an extremely rational demon.
I can't believe he would act so impulsively now.
m920171.許可しよう。ただし温泉なる文化が、\n我ら深海の民の肌に合うかはまだ分からぬ。\:
I grant you permission. However, it is still unknown whether the culture of hot springs
will suit the skin of us deep-sea folk.
Let us first gather volunteers and try it out with a small group.
m920171.謝るな、元はと言えば私の責任だ。\nそれにしてもグレーターデーモンめ、\n適当な:
Don't apologize. In the end, this is my responsibility.
Besides, that Greater Demon truly did a sloppy job.
m920171.通るわけないでしょ！ そんなこと！\nよくも私に仕事を押し付けてくれたわね！:
There's no way I'd let that slide!
How dare you dump your work on me!
m920171.過ぎたことはもういい。\n奴のやり方とはソリが合わぬ、\nそれが分かっただけでも:
Let the past be.
His methods never suited me, anyway.
At least now I know that much.
