m920184.えぇ、しかし……その、ですね……。\n伝えなければならないことがありまして……。:
Yes, but… um, well…
There is something I need to tell you all.
m920184.えぇ、ですが、この時代には王子がいる。\nそしておそらく――:
Yes. But in this age, there is the Prince.
And perhaps—
m920184.えぇ、人はちっぽけな約束すら、\n生きる糧とし、時には死ぬ理由とするのです。: Yes. People can find sustenance in even the smallest promise, and sometimes, a reason to die.
m920184.えぇ、私は人類を甘く見ていたようです。\nですから、ここに謝罪をしに来ました。:
Yes, it seems I was too lenient with humanity.
That is why I have come here to apologize.
m920184.えぇとぉ……その王子なら、\n魔力が切れて医務室で眠っていますよ？:
Umm… well, the Prince is actually asleep in the infirmary.
His mana ran out.
m920184.えぇとぉ……皆さんは、レヴィアタンが、\n遥か古の時代に、\n神々の作り出した兵:
Umm... does everyone know the theory that Leviathan
was a weapon created by the gods
in the ancient past...?
m920184.えっ……み、皆さん下がってください！\nこれは……魔神レヴィアタンの魔力が、\n:
E-Everyone, get back!
This is… the power of the Demon God Leviathan
converging with the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power—
m920184.お、王子、だめっ！ だめだよ！\n待って！ パパ、ねぇ、一緒に戦おうよ！？:
P-Prince, no! It's no good!
Wait! Dad, please, let's fight together!
m920184.お、王子っ！ 誰か、癒し手を早く！！: P-Prince! Someone, get a healer here quickly!!
m920184.おいおい、お前の目的は魔界の民じゃなく、\n亜神ディアスの守護じゃなかったか？\:
Hey, hey, wasn't your goal to protect the Lesser God Dias,
not the people of the Demon Realm?
Your willpower is strong enough to warp even mental domination, huh.
m920184.お人好しだ向こう見ずだって言われてるけど、\nつまりルキファってのは正義の味方な: They always say I'm too trusting and reckless, but... Lukifer is a hero of justice, right?
m920184.お前は自分の優先順位が低すぎるんだ。\nあのルキファといい勝負だぞ。\nこれに懲:
You really have your priorities all wrong.
You're neck and neck with that Lukifer.
If you want to learn your lesson,
better stay alive and catch up to us.
m920184.お姉さま、止めてはいけません。\nこれはマスターと、お父さまが決めることです。:
Sister, you must not stop him.
This is a decision for the Master and my father to make.
m920184.くっ……あぁぁああッ！！\nわたしに、何を……ッ！？:
Grrr… Aaaagh!!
What are you doing to me…?!
m920184.くっ……こちらも、随分と痛めつけられましたから。\nしかし、おかげでここまで、転:
Grr… I've been badly hurt as well.
But thanks to that, I was able to teleport here.
m920184.こ、こらラーワル！\nそんなに引っ張らなくても！:
C-come now, Rawal!
There's no need to pull so hard!
m920184.ここで、汝らの罪を裁いてやろう！:
Here, I shall judge your sins!
--- scene: The Dawn Arrives ---
m920184.ここは……あ、アイギス神殿、でしょうか？: This is… ah, the Aigis Temple, isn't it?
m920184.この世界を守護する力、\n三女神の力が、亜神ディアスの手に……？:
The power to protect this world,
the power of the Three Goddesses, in the hands of the Lesser God Dias…?
m920184.この先は共に歩んでくれるのだろう？ もね。: And that we'll walk this path together from here on.
m920184.この雷……どこかで……っ！: This lightning…… I've seen it somewhere……!
m920184.これから天界トノ戦いも激しくナッテいくノダ！\nソンナゆるゆるの表情でドウスル！:
The battles against the Celestial Realm are going to intensify!
What kind of expression is that slack, easygoing face!
m920184.これだけの規模の儀式、\n見過ごせという方が無理な話でしょう。:
A ritual of this magnitude?
It would be unreasonable to expect us to just look the other way.
m920184.これは……我々のしようとしていることは、\n彼らへの裏切りなのだろうな。: Ah... the hero who saved the Demon Realm. Our benefactor is here.
m920184.これは、転移魔術！？\nだめです！ 対抗する時間が……！！:
This is a teleportation spell!?
No! There's no time to counter it…!!
m920184.これは慈悲である。\n我が甘言が、オリュンポスへ至れという誘いが、\nその実力を:
Consider this an act of mercy.
My sweet words, my invitation to reach Olympus,
must have led you to misjudge your own strength.
m920184.さぁて、覚悟しろよルキファ。\nこういう精神支配ってぇのは、\n頭をどついてやれ:
Alright, brace yourself, Lukifer.

This kind of mind control

usually clears up if you just bonk the head a bit—
m920184.さぁみんな、このまま儀式の間へ。\nそれから、亜神イルドナ様、\nあなたも回復し:
Now then, everyone, let's head to the ritual chamber.
And, Demi-God Ildona,
please follow us as soon as you have recovered.
m920184.さぁ王子よ、此度の人類への罰、\n貴様らを死地へ向かわせた、\n愚かな扇動者たる:
Now, Prince. Let us show the foolish agitators,
the Three Goddesses who drove you to this death,
the punishment for humanity!
m920184.さらばだ、我が唯一の友よ。\n安寧と停滞の世界で、\nただ余のみが、貴様を覚えて:
Farewell, my only friend.
In a world of peace and stagnation,
I alone will remember you.
m920184.されど、神殺しを成した王子という存在に、\n神たる力を重ねたなら、そこに可能性も:
Yet, if the power of a god were layered upon
the existence of the Prince, who has slain gods,
then a possibility might emerge.
m920184.しかし、余も人類に感化されたか……。\n王子がここへ至ったことに、\n少々心躍っ:
Perhaps I have been influenced by humanity as well……
The fact that I feel a certain thrill
at the Prince's arrival here is no lie.
m920184.しばらくは絶対安静、ですわね。\n一週間ほどは執務も休んでもらわないと。:
He needs absolute rest for the time being.
I'd say he should be off from his duties for at least a week.
m920184.すみません、軽率でした。\n数多の伝説を残す彼が、\nそう簡単に負けるはずもあり:
I'm sorry, that was careless of me.
He's a man who has left behind countless legends.
He wouldn't fall so easily.
m920184.そ、そうです！\n戦わなかったら、世界は滅んでいたんですから！:
T-that's right!
If we hadn't fought, the world would have been destroyed!
m920184.そういうのは隠すとろくなことにならないんだぜ？\nともあれ、あっちは千年戦争を戦:
Hiding things like that never ends well, you know?

Anyway, they've brought out a legendary Fallen Angel

who fought in the Millennium War.
m920184.そうして最後は、\nこれからよろしく頼む、でしょうか。:
And finally, he'll probably say,
"I look forward to working with you."
m920184.そうしなければ、この世界はなかった。\nガリウスを倒していなければ、\n今の物質:
Without it, this world would not exist.
If we hadn't defeated Garius,
the Material Plane would have long since been reduced to ashes.
m920184.そうは言っても――って、\nなっ、リヴンどうして……こほんっ、\nリヴン様、どう:
I know, but—wait,

Wh—Riven, why are you… cough,

Lord Riven, why are you here…!?
m920184.そしてこれこそが、真なる神の雷霆である。: And this is the true divine thunder.
m920184.そのディアスは、現在魔王城内で、\n大規模な儀式を行使しているようです。\nルキ:
That Dias is currently performing a large-scale ritual
inside the Demon King's Castle.
Lukifer, do you have any idea what it might be?
m920184.その上、可愛い臣下までできて。\n今度こそ、絶対に、助けないといけないわね。:
On top of that, he's gained a cute retainer.
This time, absolutely, we must save him.
m920184.その彼が、英雄王の子孫たる王子だ。\n……よく、無事に戻ってきてくれたな、ルキフ:
That man is the Prince, descendant of the Hero King.
...Good that you returned safely, Lukifer.
m920184.その答えは、千年前に既に出ていたというのに、\n私はそれを信じきれませんでした。:
The answer had been given a thousand years ago,
yet I could not bring myself to fully believe it.
m920184.それが正しいとすると、なんですけどぉ……。: If that theory is correct, then...
m920184.それで、今にも倒れてしまいそうなのに、\n私たちの肩まで借りて、\nこうしてここ:
And yet, on the verge of collapse,
he leaned on our shoulders
and made it this far.
m920184.それでもなお、\nあえて人類の相手をしたのはなぜだ。\nただの滅びが、目的ではな:
And yet, why did he still choose to engage with humanity?
It must be because mere annihilation was not his goal, no?
m920184.それとも、人類と仲良くしようって、\n宗旨替えでもしたのかしら。:
Or did you have a change of heart and decide
to get along with humanity?
m920184.それにしても、お前たちに成長の時間を与え、\nオリュンポスの頂に至るまで\n待っ:
And yet, I told you that I would grant you time to grow,
and wait until you reached the peak of Olympus.
m920184.それにしても、亜神ディアスの最後の言葉、\n信用していいのでしょうか……。:
Still, Dias's final words…
Can we really trust them?
m920184.それを容易く人に授けるなど、\nその行いが世界にどれだけの影響を与えるのか、\n:
To so casually bestow such power upon humans…
I truly doubt you understand
the impact such an act has on the world.
m920184.それを救ってくれたのが、為政者たるアスバール様と、\n正義の執行者たるルキファ様:
Those who saved us were Lord Asval, our ruler,
and Lukifer, the executor of justice.
m920184.それを浅慮だと言うのだ。\nガリウスは、本当に世界を滅ぼそうとしていたのか？:
I call that shallow thinking.
Did Garius truly intend to destroy the world?
m920184.そんなすごい人を、\n支配されっぱなしになんてできないよね。\nさぁ、最後の術式:
I can't let someone that amazing
stay under someone else's control.
Alright, I'm going to shatter the final formation!
m920184.ただの被造物たる人類に、そんな力はない。\n運命に翻弄され、偶然に一喜一憂し、\:
Humanity, mere creations, possess no such power.
To be tossed about by fate, to rejoice and grieve over chance,
and to march toward a predetermined death—that is what humanity is.
m920184.だから、私はただ、\nこの約束を守ると己に誓ったのですよ。: So I merely swore to myself that I would keep that promise.
m920184.だが……そうだな、こんな感覚は初めてだ。\n素晴らしい、これが人の可能性というも:
But…… yes, this is a sensation I have never felt before.
Magnificent. So this is the potential of humanity.
m920184.だが、ここまでだ。\nもはやその身体で、儀式を止めることはできまい。:
But this is where it ends.
That body of yours can no longer stop the ritual.
m920184.だが、人という不確定な存在を、\n貴様が導き続けられると証明するのなら、\n我が:
But if you can prove that you are capable
of continuing to guide such an uncertain species as humans,
I will admit that my answer was a mistake.
m920184.だが、礎となれるはずだ。\nダークエルフとオークが亜神ディアスに弓引くよりも、\: This is... what we're doing must be a betrayal of them.
m920184.だろうな……。\n残念だ、我が隣に立つに値する男だというのに。:
I suppose so…
What a pity. You were a man worthy of standing at my side.
m920184.ちっ……アルヴァ！\n王子を連れてどこかに転移しろ！！\nこいつだけでも生き延び:
Tch… Alva!
Teleport the Prince somewhere, now!!
If he alone survives—
m920184.ちょっとだけ、\n人間の勉強が足りていなかったみたいね？\n――さぁみんな、急い:
It seems you have a bit of a gap
in your understanding of humans, don't you?
—Come on, everyone, hurry!
m920184.てめぇが不甲斐ないから、\n子供が立派に育ったんだよ。:
It's because you were such a failure
that they grew up to be such fine people.
m920184.で、でも、それってまずいですわよ……？\n精神支配されたままでありながら、\n本:
B-but that's troublesome, isn't it...?
It means that even while under mental domination,
you can still unleash your full power.
m920184.でも、その凶行を止める力も、人は持っている。\nその片鱗を感じたからこそ、\nあ:
But humans possess the power to stop such atrocities, too.
It was because you sensed that glimmer
that you decided to wait for the Prince. Am I wrong?
m920184.となれば、こっちも同じく英傑の出番、だろ？\nルキファ、なぁおい！ ひっさしぶり:
Which means it's time for our own heroes to step up, right?

Lukifer, hey there! Long time no see, huh!
m920184.なっ……イルドナが分身したぁ！？: Wha… Ildona has split into multiple copies!
m920184.なっ……ザエモン！ それは秘密だと言っただろう！: Wh—Gorozaemon! I told you that was a secret!
m920184.なっ……ルキファ、さま？\nなぜここに……！？:
Wha... Lukifer?
Why are you here...!?
m920184.なっ、リヴンに言われたくないぞ。\n……はぁ。待っているからな、イルドナ。\n光:
Hah, I don't need a lecture from you, Riven.
……Sigh. I'll be waiting, Ildona.
Act like the Demi-God of Light you claim to be,
and play the hero properly!
m920184.ならば、なぜ奴はかつて人類と戦いを続けたのだ。\n魔物に蹂躙され、文明を退行させ:
If so, why did he continue to wage war against humanity in the past?
He could have crushed those who were trampled by monsters
and caused civilization to regress far more easily than he did.
m920184.なるほど、ようやく理解できました。\nでは、その共に戦う仲間として、\nひとつ頼:
I see. I finally understand.
Then, as one of those companions in battle,
may I ask you for a small favor?
m920184.なんとも、生き急ぐものだ。\nアスバール、貴様がついていてなお、\nか弱き人類た:
How hasty of you to be alive.
Asbaal, even with you at his side,
you would send the frail human Prince to his death……
m920184.はぁっ……はぁっ……。\nどれだけ、魔力を持っていくの……。\n魔剣に呼びかける:
Haa… haa…
How much magic are you taking…
I was told it would only be a call to the magic sword…

Haa… haa…
How much magic are you taking…
I was told it would only be a call to the magic sword…
m920184.はっ、いえ、妹は随分と昔に、\n物質界へ逃げ延びさせたので……。\nこんな所で会:
Hah, no, I sent my sister
to the Material World a long time ago…
I never imagined we'd meet in a place like this――
m920184.はっ、えっ？ どの子？\nグレーテルちゃんのこと？:
Hah, what? Which one?
You mean Gretel?
m920184.はっ、急ぎますわよ！\nメーリス、あなたも手伝ってくださいな！:
Hah, I'm on it!
Maelis, help me out!
m920184.ふざけたことを。\n我が願いはこの世界の未来である。:
Don't be ridiculous.
My wish is the future of this world.
m920184.ふふ、あれは契約などという、\n大仰なものではありませんよ。: Heh, it was hardly the sort of grand affair you'd call a contract.
m920184.ふふ、また悪行をなしてしまったな。\n兄妹を再会させてしまうとは。:
Fufu, I've committed another misdeed.
Reuniting a brother and sister.
m920184.ふふっ。\n――あっ、ところで、\n王子が彼の謝罪を受けたら、なんと返すと思いま:
Fufu.
—Ah, by the way,
do you think the Prince will accept his apology?
m920184.まさか人類が、\n魔物に抗する力を維持し続けたとでも？\nあの英雄王の誕生まで、:
Surely you don't believe that humanity
managed to maintain the strength to resist the monsters?
That they continued to protect the world until the birth of that Hero King?
m920184.まさか貴様ほどの亜神が、\nその身を犠牲に時間稼ぎとはな……。: I can't believe a demi-god of your stature would sacrifice your own body to buy time.
m920184.まずは、敵を蹴散らすとしましょうか。\nルキファを救おうにも、\n足止めされてい:
Let's scatter the enemy first, then.
If we're held up,
we won't be able to save Lukifer.
m920184.まったく、無理しやがって。\nほーぅ、亜神でも脂汗はかくんだなぁ？:
Honestly, why do you push yourself so hard?
Hmph, so even Lesser Gods break into a cold sweat, huh?
m920184.まったくだ。\n今度呑みにでも誘ってみるかねェ。:
Indeed.
Perhaps we should invite him out for a drink sometime.
m920184.もう十分に戦った。\nだが、ああ、もし叶うのならば……。:
We have fought enough.
But, ah, if it were possible to...
m920184.もったいぶるな、アンブローズ。\n悪い癖だぞ？:
Stop beating around the bush, Ambrose.
That's a bad habit of yours.
m920184.や、ヤメロっ！ ナゼそんな笑顔で！\nアァ、マッタク……！！:
S-stop it! Why are you smiling like that!
Ah, for goodness' sake…!!
m920184.やり方が乱暴なのだ、お前は。\n王子よ、王国軍に精神支配解除の専門家はいるだろう:
Your method is rather crude, Gorozaemon.

Prince, does the Kingdom's army have any specialists in lifting mind control?
m920184.やるな……。\nさすがは王子、魔界武術大会の覇者だ……！:
Not bad...
Truly the Prince, the conqueror of the Demon Realm Martial Arts Tournament...!
m920184.ゆえに、亜神イルドナの力も受け継がず、\n余を滅ぼす力も身に着けず、\nここに立:
Therefore, your rashness and reckless courage—
standing here without inheriting the power of the Lesser God Ildona,
nor acquiring the strength to destroy me—
deserve punishment.
m920184.ゆえに、貴様らに許されし唯一の感情は諦めなのだ。\n自由意志を手放し、安寧と停滞:
Therefore, the only emotion permitted to you is resignation.
To surrender your free will, and to end your life as a cog
within a state of peace and stagnation—that is the righteous path.
m920184.ようやく力を取り戻してきたというのに、\n声もかけてくれぬとは、遠慮し過ぎなので:
After finally regaining your strength,

and not even bothering to give us a heads-up? You are being far too modest, aren't you?
m920184.よくやってくれました、グリムさん。\nあんな滅茶苦茶な魔力の流れだったのに、\n:
You did well, Grimm.
With that chaotic flow of mana,
it's a miracle no one got separated.
m920184.よし、王子！ このまま突っ切るぜ！: Alright, Prince! Let's push right through!
m920184.わっ、わかった！\n即席で解呪の魔法を組み立てて……。:
W-What? Got it!
I'll throw together a hasty dispelling spell…
m920184.わっ、パパ連れてくる場所間違えちゃった？\nよーし、医務室行くよ！ 医務室！:
Waa! Did we bring Papa to the wrong place?
Alright, let's go to the infirmary! To the infirmary!
m920184.ん……少し待て、覚えがある……。\n確か奴は、三女神の力の痕跡と、\nレヴィアタ:
Hm... wait, I remember something...
I believe he was attempting to connect the traces of the Three Goddesses' power
to Leviathan.
m920184.んっふっふ、パパはねぇ、\nみんなに謝りたいらしいよ？: Nfu-fu, Papa says he wants to apologize to everyone.
m920184.アトにぃともよくぶつかってた。\nふたりとも強情だから、全然会話が噛み合わなくて:
I also clashed with Atna a lot.
You two are both so stubborn that you never seemed to get along.
m920184.アンブローズが、生き延びた仲間たちと、\n王国そのものを託されたように。: And Ambrose was entrusted with the surviving comrades and the kingdom itself.
m920184.イ、イルドナ……？\nいったい、どうやってここに……？:
I, Ildona…?
How did you get here…?
m920184.イルドナ、もう大丈夫なのか？\n魔界から転送門も無しに直接転移するだなんて、\n:
Ildona, are you alright?
Teleporting directly from the Demon Realm without a gate…
That must have drained an amount of mana that could have erased you from existence.
m920184.イルドナは昔から、勝手に行動しては、\n勝手に戦果を上げてくる困った男だったから:
Ildona has always been a troublesome man who acts on his own
and racks up victories on his own.
He's causing us trouble again this time.
m920184.イルドナ様、私たちの先祖に、\nフラガラッハを託してくださった偉大なるお方。:
Ildona-sama, our ancestors were entrusted with Flagarah
by a great being.
m920184.イルドナ！ 無事だったか。\n済まなかったな、私が操られていなければ、\nもっと:
Ildona! You're unharmed.
I'm sorry. If I hadn't been under control,
I could have rushed to your side much sooner…
m920184.オッホン！\nサ、サァゴブリン軍団ヨ！\nさっそく訓練に移るノダ！！:
Cough!
N-now then, Goblin Legion!
We're moving straight into training!!
m920184.オリュンポスで待つ、ね……。\n本当なら信じたくはないけれど――:
He said he'd be waiting at Olympus…
I wish I didn't have to believe it, but—
m920184.オークの誇りまで、曲げさせてしまったな。\n後悔は、していないか？:
We have even been forced to bend the pride of the Orcs.
Do you have no regrets?
m920184.キミにも言い分はあるだろうけど！\nそんなに民に慕われてるキミを、\n苦しませた:
I know you have your reasons!
But I can't just leave you, who is so beloved by the people,
suffering like this!!
m920184.ギャギャ！ クンレン！ クンレン！\nイザススメー！！:
Gya-gya! Training! Training!
Let's get to it!!
m920184.ケラウノスよ、その力は貴様のものではない。\n天界に君臨しながらも、人類に倒され:
Keraunos, that power does not belong to you.
Though you ruled the heavens, you were felled by humanity
because you did not know how to wield lightning.
m920184.ケラウノス様が――ぐぅッ……ディ、アス様が……。\n私たちを、正しき形に作り直し:
Keraunos-sama—grrrk……Dias-sama……
will remake us into our proper form.
m920184.コレは個人的ナ話デアルが……。\n今後ハ、トモとして、お前に接しても……。:
This is a personal matter, but…
From now on, if I were to treat you as a friend…
m920184.ゴブリン軍団ニモ、王国軍ニモ、\n複雑な心境の者タチはイルことダロウ……。:
There are probably some with complicated feelings,
whether on the Goblin Legion side or the Kingdom side…
m920184.サァ諸君、このパレードはタダの行進ではナイ！\n未来へ続く進軍にナルと、\nワタ:
Now then, everyone! This parade is no mere procession!
I believe it will become an advance toward the future!!
m920184.サレド！ 王子は敵でアル我らにも、\nその手を差し伸べ続けてくれてイル。: And yet! Even to us, who are your enemies, the Prince has continued to extend his hand.
m920184.ザエモン……。\nくっ……なんだ、この記憶は……。\n私は、神の剣……ディアス様:
Gorozaemon…

Ugh… what is this memory…

I am the Sword of God… Lord Dias's…
m920184.ソシテ！ ツイニ！ コノ記念すべき日、\nゴブリン軍団と、王国との合同パレードが:
And! Finally! On this momentous day,
a joint parade between the Goblin Legion and the Kingdom has become a reality!!
m920184.ソラスが未来の英雄――今の王子たちへの\n助力を任せられたように。: Just as Solas was entrusted with aiding the heroes of the future—our current Princes—
m920184.ディアス、つまりそれは、\n世界の書き換えをやめるということかしら？:
Dias, does that mean you're
going to stop rewriting the world?
m920184.ディアス、様……。\nああ、そうだな、そのとおりだ。\n――全軍剣をとれ、王国軍:
Dias-sama……
Ah, yes. That is correct.
——All units, draw your blades. We will meet the Kingdom's army.
m920184.ナラバ、我らもその手を握り返し、\n敵ではアレド、滅すべき敵ではナク、\n好敵手: So perhaps we should take that hand in return, and, though we remain foes, walk forward not as enemies to be destroyed, but as worthy rivals!
m920184.ヘンゼルさん……。\n王子、今は先を急ぎましょう。\nこのまま魔王城へ突入します:
Hansel…….
Prince, we should press on now.
Let's charge straight into the Demon King's Castle!
m920184.ヘンゼルさんに頼まれてしまいましたし、\n必ず、彼女を亜神ディアスから解放しまし: Ah... that sounds exactly like something Lord Lukifer would say.
m920184.ヘンゼルさんは、\n以前魔界での戦いを助けてくれたんです。\nしかし、どうして亜:
Hansel helped us
in a previous battle in the Demon Realm.
But why is he on the side of the Lesser God Dias……?
m920184.メカゴブリンクイーン様、\nそして盟友タル王子の友誼ガ、永遠たらんコトヲ！！:
May the friendship of Mecha Goblin Queen-sama
and our ally, the Prince, last forever!!
m920184.ラーワル……いえ、それには語弊が……。: Rawal… No, that's not quite the right way to put it.
m920184.リヴンだよ。\nあの戦いの後に、姿を変えたんだそうだ。:
That's Riven.
Apparently, she changed her appearance after that battle.
m920184.ルキファ、あなた、\n操られていてもなお、自分の意識が……。:
Lukifer, even though you are under control,
your own will is still...
m920184.ルキファ、僕らは、キミを取り戻す。\nこの後には亜神ディアスが待ってるんだ。\n:
Lukifer, we're going to get you back.
The Lesser God Dias is waiting for us after this.
No matter how much you resist, you'll fight with us as a comrade.
m920184.ルキファ、千年戦争の時には、いっぱい喧嘩したよね。\nキミはどう見ても正義の味方:
Lukifer, we fought a lot during the Millennium War, right?
Even though you were clearly on the side of justice,
you kept stubbornly insisting that you were evil.
m920184.ルキファか……。\nなんつーのか、人間以上のお人好しっていうか、\n他人のことし:
Lukifer, huh…….
How should I put it, he's a good soul beyond human measure,
or maybe just a fool who only thinks of others?
m920184.ルキファ様、よかった……！\nありがとう、王子、シャルロットさん、メーリスさん…:
Lukifer-sama, thank goodness…!
Thank you, Prince, Charlotte, Mehlis…
m920184.ルキファ様、王国軍が進軍を開始しました。\n迎撃の指揮をお願いします。:
Lukifer-sama, the Kingdom's army has begun its advance.
Please take command of the interception.
m920184.レヴィアタンが物質界から離れたことで、\n運良く魔界に落ちることができたのかもし:
Perhaps he was lucky enough to fall into the Demon Realm
when Leviathan departed the Material World.
m920184.世界の未来と、亜神一柱の命……。\n簡単な選択でしょう。:
The future of the world, and the life of a single Demi-God…
It is a simple choice.
m920184.主の御言葉こそが正義なれば、\n全てを救わんとする我が行いこそ悪である。\nそし:
If the Master's word is justice,
then my actions to save all are evil.
And to defy the gods is, without a doubt, the truest form of evil.
m920184.互いに解決スベキことは残されてイルが、\nされど、この行事がヒトツの節目となるハ:
There are still things we need to resolve between us,
but this event should serve as a milestone.
m920184.亜神イルドナが、時間を稼いでくれています。\n王子、彼のためにも、魔界の民のため:
The Demigod Ildona is buying us time.
Prince, for his sake, and for the sake of the demon race,
let us crush the Demigod Dias's scheme.
m920184.亜神イルドナの助力があったと言っても、\n力を取り戻した亜神ディアスの、\nあの: Even with Ildona's help, he still took that lightning bolt head-on…
m920184.亜神ディアスは、天使を支配する、\n何らかの装置を所持しています。\nその影響下:
The Lesser God Dias possesses some kind of device
that allows him to dominate the angels.
Since you were under its influence, there is nothing to be done about it.
m920184.人の持つ最も強い力は、\n絶対に諦めないという、その誓いだ。:
The strongest power that humans possess
is the vow to never, ever give up.
m920184.人の自由意志に任せていれば、\n物質界は容易く滅びるだろう。\nそれくらい、貴様:
Left to the free will of humans,
the material world would perish easily.
I thought you understood that much.
m920184.人を助けてまわっているのに、悪、ですか？: Justice, huh? I suppose he is a hero of justice. He always said he was walking the path of evil, though.
m920184.人類が神に届くかもしれないと、\nそう期待したがゆえに、誤解させたのなら――:
If I led you to misunderstand
because I hoped humanity might reach the gods—
m920184.人類が神に届くかもしれないと、\nそう期待したがゆえに、誤解させてしまったか……:
I allowed myself to hope that humanity might reach the gods,
and in doing so, I let you misunderstand…
m920184.今の物質界連合軍の力では、\n亜神ディアスに、未だ及びません。:
The current strength of the Material World Coalition
is still not enough to match the Demi-God Dias.
m920184.仕方ないですよ。\n王国にも、ゴブリン軍団にも、\n互いに禍根は色々と残ったまま:
I suppose that's only to be expected.
There are still plenty of lingering grievances on both the Kingdom's and the Goblin Legion's side.
m920184.以前の魔王決戦の時には及びませんが、\n兵の力を高めることができますよ！: It may not be as potent as during the last war against the Demon King, but it should be enough to boost our troops' strength!
m920184.仮説どころかただの空想ですけど……。\n敵は亜神ですから、そういう技術も持ってい:
It's more of a fantasy than a hypothesis, but...
The enemy is a Lesser God, so perhaps they do possess such technology...
m920184.任せておけ、汝らに、ひとりも犠牲は出さぬ。: Leave it to me. I will not let a single one of you fall.
m920184.何故、泣いている……。\n汝は……妹と再会するまで、泣かぬと言っていただろう。:
Why are you weeping…?
You swore you wouldn't shed a tear until you reunited with your sister.
m920184.余が敵、だと？\n戦神はやはり、世界の維持には向かぬ存在だな。:
I, your enemy?
So the War God is indeed unfit for maintaining the world.
m920184.儀式の段階が進んだ――いえ、\n亜神イルドナが時間を稼いでいてくれたのですから、:
The ritual has progressed—no,
since the demi-god Ildona bought us time,
he must already be…
m920184.其は神の力、即ち命を分けた、\n神そのものとも言うべきものである。:
It is the power of a god, a fragment of their life force,
and thus, a part of the god themselves.
m920184.創造神よ、見ているか。\n貴様の愚行により奪われし力、\n今この手に戻ってきたぞ:
Creator God, do you watch?
The power stolen by your folly
has returned to my hand.
m920184.否定はせぬ。\nだが、それに任せていれば、\nこの世界が滅びる方が早かろう。:
I do not deny it.
But if we leave it to that,
this world will perish sooner.
m920184.堕天使から意思を奪い、\nむりやり天使に戻すとは、さすがは亜神か。:
To strip the will from a fallen angel
and forcibly restore them to an angel... truly befitting a Lesser God.
m920184.天使は間違えることなどありません。\n意思などという、不要な装置を我々は持ちませ:
Angels do not err.
We do not possess such an unnecessary mechanism as “will.”
Once this battle is over, let us go in for maintenance.
m920184.女神アイギスの神官か……？\nよかろう、この盾の本来の力を見せてやろう。:
A priestess of the goddess Aigis, are you……?
Very well. I'll show you the true power of this shield.
m920184.奴はルキファ様に、何か思い入れがあるみたいだ。\n時間をかけて魔力を注ぎ、天使に:
He seems to have some kind of attachment to Lord Lukifer.
He spent time pouring his magic into him,
turning him back into an angel.
m920184.実に惜しい、その身が人ではなく、\n神であれば我が同志となれたであろうに。:
Truly a shame. Had that body been divine rather than human,
you might have become one of my comrades.
m920184.幸いなことに、三女神の力の残滓が\nこの辺りにも存在します。: Fortunately, traces of the Three Goddesses' power still linger in this area.
m920184.思い出す必要はありません、ルキファ様。\nあのような裏切り者の言葉に、耳を傾けて:
There is no need to recall such things, Lord Lukifer.

You must not lend an ear to the words of a traitor like that.
m920184.我が剣を受け継ぎし姫君に、\nひとつ頼み事をしただけですよ。\n本当に必要なとき:
I merely asked the princess who inherited my blade for one small favor.
I asked her to call for me when she truly needed me.
m920184.我らの子を、愛する者を、戦いから救った王子と、\nルキファ様に、我らの最後の戦い:
Let us dedicate our final battle to the Prince, who saved our children and loved ones from war,
and to Lukifer.
m920184.我ラはカツテ、宿敵同士でアッタ！\nソシテ今も、物質界連合を成し遂げたガ、\n種:
We were once sworn enemies!
And even now, though we've achieved the Material World Alliance,
that doesn't mean all the misunderstandings between our races have vanished.
m920184.擬似的に、三女神の力が、\nそれも女神の所有していない純粋な状態で手に入る、と？:
You mean it would allow one to obtain the power of the Three Goddesses,
in a pure state not even the goddesses possess?
m920184.敵対しようとしてるから、じゃないです？\n最後の仕上げって、いったい何をするつも:
Because he's acting hostile, isn't it?
What is he planning to do for this "final stage"?!
m920184.昔の仲間まで忘れるたぁ、\n亜神ディアスの精神支配装置ってのは\n随分と高性能み:
Forgetting even your old comrades, huh.

Demigod Dias's mind control device

seems pretty high-tech, doesn't it.
m920184.正義、なるほど、確かに正義の味方だな。\nあやつはいつも、自分は悪を行くと言って: Then it's up to us to save him!
m920184.残念だ、少しは期待させてくれるかと思ったが。\nその程度の実力では、\nオリュン:
What a pity. I thought you might have given me a little hope.
With power of that magnitude,
you will never reach the peak of Olympus.
m920184.民を救うのが――ぐっ……くぁ……っ！\n亜神、ディアス様の儀式完遂まで、\n魔王:
Saving the people is—gah... kua...!
Defending the Demon King's Castle until the Lesser God Dias
completes his ritual... that is... our duty...
m920184.永遠のチャンプ、アナトリア様、\n現チャンプ、王子の戦いを、もう一度見てから死に:
To see the battle between the Eternal Champion, Lord Anatolia,
and the current Champion, the Prince, one more time before I die—
m920184.浄化を受け入れよ。\n穢れた大地は、焼き払わねばならぬ。:
Accept purification.
The defiled earth must be burned away.
m920184.無力なる人類よ、これは罰だ。\n我が力を奪いし三女神と、道を過ち続ける人類への。:
You powerless humans, this is your punishment.
For the Three Goddesses who stole my power,
and for humanity, which continues to walk the wrong path.
m920184.王国を訪ねてみれば、\n王子たちは魔界へ向かったというではないか。:
I heard that after visiting the Kingdom,

the Princes were heading toward the Demon Realm.
m920184.王子、このまま上層へ抜けます！\nおそらく敵の待ち伏せがあるはずです。\nいつで: Since Hansel asked me to, I will definitely free her from the Lesser God Dias.
m920184.王子、敵の戦線が崩れました。\n上層へ向かうならば、今が好機です。: Prince, the enemy line has broken. If we're heading to the upper floors, now is our chance.
m920184.王子が、あらゆる生命の敵であるあなたと、\n友だちになんてなると思う？:
You expect the Prince to be friends with you?
You're the enemy of all life!
m920184.王子くんが、そんな道を選ぶはずがありません。\n何も変わらぬ停滞の世界など、決し:
There is no way the Prince would choose such a path.
A world of stagnation where nothing ever changes… never.
m920184.王子と戦ったという、この事実だけで、\n末代までの武勇伝とできるだろうな。:
The mere fact that we fought the Prince
would make for a legendary tale to be told for generations.
m920184.王子にはちょうどいい休暇かもしれません。\n今のうちに、兵にも交代で休暇をとって:
It might be a welcome break for the Prince.
We should arrange for the soldiers to take shifts off while he's recovering.
m920184.王子みたいな存在は、きっとどの時代にだっている。\nなんなら、困ってるやつを見捨:
There's always someone like the Prince in every age.
In fact, there are plenty of good-natured fools
around who can't leave people in trouble behind.
m920184.王子殿下、先程魔王城内部に、\n高出力の魔力の揺らぎを感知しました。\nおそらく:
Your Highness, I detected a high-power magical fluctuation
inside the Demon King's Castle just now.
It is likely from the Demigod Dias.
m920184.目覚めの時ですわよ、堕天使さま。\nあなたの逸話は本で何度も読みましたわ。:
It's time to wake up, Fallen Angel.
I've read your legends in books so many times.
m920184.直撃を受けたら、たとえ亜神でも、\n欠片すら残らないわね……。\nソラス、サナラ:
If that hits us directly, even a demigod wouldn't have a single fragment left…
Solais, Sanara, I'm sorry. Please, lend me your strength.
m920184.神の被造物たる人類を、\n安寧と諦観の内に生き長らえさせ、\nこの世界を永続させ:
To let humanity, the creation of the gods,
live on in peace and resignation,
and to preserve this world eternally—that is my mission.
m920184.神の言葉こそ正義、ならばそれに背き、\n独自に行動する自分は悪である、だったか？: Saving people all over the place, and calling it evil?
m920184.神獣と魔神が、元は共通の存在だという説ですか？\n一部はそれが事実だと判明してい:
The theory that divine beasts and demon gods
were originally the same existence?
It has been proven that part of that is true,
but a Leviathan of this scale, the very Demon Realm itself?
m920184.神自らが紡いだ、強大な魔力の結晶であるレヴィアタン。\nその魔力を、三女神の力の:
Leviathan, a crystal of immense magical power
woven by the gods themselves.
If that power were channeled into the remnants of the Three Goddesses' power...
m920184.私たちの命と魔力を束ねれば、\n王子くんひとりくらいなら守れるかもしれません。:
If we combine our lives and magic,
we might just be able to protect the Prince.
m920184.私はただ、この世界を継続させ続けることを、\nそしてそれを見守ることを、\n英雄: I simply promised the Hero King that I would keep this world going, and watch over it.
m920184.約束……約束か……！\nそんな他愛もない口約束のために、\n貴様はこの千年、暗躍:
A promise… just a promise!
For such a trivial, off-the-cuff pledge, you've been scheming in the shadows for a thousand years?!
m920184.膨大すぎる魔力が、空間を破壊しています。\nあれは雷の魔法ではありません。\n空:
The massive amount of magic power is destroying space itself.
That is not a lightning spell.
I judge that space is undergoing a chain reaction of ruptures.
m920184.英傑も、今の時代に生きる民も、\n王子にとっては等しく、\n共に戦う仲間で、守る:
Whether they are heroes of old or the people of this age,
to the Prince, they are all equal—
companions in battle and people to be protected.
m920184.英雄王との契約か。\n確か、世界の味方をせよ、だったか？\nそのために命すら投げ:
A contract with the Hero King, was it?
I recall the terms being something like “side with the world.”
To throw away your very life for that…
m920184.英雄王の子孫たちが、私の子供たちが、\nそして、彼らと共に戦うことを決意した\n:
The descendants of the Hero King, my children,
and the oaths of the countless warriors who have resolved to fight alongside them—
m920184.英雄王の意志と名を継ぐ者、人類種の英雄、\n魔王を討ちし神殺しにして、世界を担う:
You who inherit the will and name of the Hero King, hero of the human race,
god-slayer who slew the Demon King, and bearer of the world's weight,
show me your true strength in my final battle!
m920184.英雄王ほどの傑物が、\nこの先の未来にも存在するとは思えなかった、のだろう？:
You couldn't believe that a figure as extraordinary as the Hero King
would exist in the future, could you?
m920184.謝る必要はない、かしら。: I suppose he'll say there's no need to apologize.
m920184.貴様が人ではなく、神であったなら、\n良き友となれたやもしれぬな。:
Had you been a god rather than a human,
you might have made a fine friend.
m920184.迷える人々のために、翼を黒く染めた最初の天使。\n施すだけでなく、共に立ち上がる:
The first angel to dye her wings black for the sake of the lost.
A righteous soul who doesn't just bestow aid, but gives others the strength to rise with her.
Lukifer, the hero who heralds the dawn.
m920184.長らく、神に挑もうなどという者はいなかった。\nあのガリウスすら、もはや神とは呼:
For a long time, no one dared to challenge the gods.
Even that Garius, having lost the right to be called a god,
finally brought his story to an end.
m920184.魔力の揺らぎ方から、\n何らかの儀式が進行していることは間違いありません。:
Judging by the nature of the magical fluctuation,
it is certain that some kind of ritual is underway.
m920184.魔王との決戦で、民を守るために\n自分を犠牲に結界を張ったんだよ、あいつ。\nそ:
In the decisive battle with the Demon King, he sacrificed himself
to raise a barrier to protect the people.
That's what caused him to be pushed outside the Material World…….
m920184.魔王に蹂躙されし、無実の民を救うためです！\nそのためにあなたは堕天し、己の意思:
It was to save the innocent people crushed by the Demon King!

That is why you fell from the heavens, to claim your own will!
m920184.魔界と物質界の往来が絶たれた後、\n王子たちの目の届かぬこの地は、\n再び動乱の:
After the passage between the Demon Realm and the Material World was cut off,
this land, beyond the Prince's reach,
was on the verge of descending into chaos once more.
m920184.黙りなさいッ！\n亜神ディアス、まさかルキファ様にまで精神支配を――:
Silence!

Demigod Dias, so you have even subjected Lord Lukifer to mind control—
m920184.黙れ。我が翼は、我が力は、\n罪なき者たちのために振るわれる。:
Silence. My wings, my power,
shall be wielded for the sake of the innocent.
m920184.（――汝、正義たれ、善き行いをせよ。\n正しさとは主の御言葉にほかならぬ）:
（――Be just, and do good.
Righteousness is nothing but the Word of the Lord.）
m920184.（おい、もう少し緊張感ってやつをだな……。\nいや、だが確かに、見覚えが――）: (Besides, doesn't Hansel remind me of someone? I feel like I've seen a similar face in the Royal Army before...)
m920184.（それにしても、ヘンゼルさんって誰かに似てません？\n王国軍で、似た子を見たこと: Prince, let's make our way to the upper floors! There's likely an ambush waiting for us. Please have everyone ready for battle!
m920184.（ならば私は、何のために堕天を――\n否、違う、私は堕ちてなど……）:
(Then why did I fall from grace—
No, that's not it. I did not fall…)

m950001.うふふ、やる気満々のようね。\nでも、いつも通りに戦えるとは限らないよ。\n魔女: Hehe, you look so eager. But you can't be sure you'll fight as usual. You'll come to know a witch's power.
m950001.ここが忌々しい女神アイギスの神殿だね。\nふふ、すぐにボロボロにしてやるよ。\n: This is the cursed shrine of the goddess Aigis. Heh, I'll tear it to pieces soon. Come on, you all, head out.
m950001.この前はよくもやってくれたね！\n今回はもっとすごいの連れてきたよ。\nさあ、ぶ: You did well last time! This time I've brought something even more impressive. Come on, let's feed you something hefty!
m950001.この女神様の神殿がどうしても邪魔な\nようですね。\n絶対に守り抜きましょう。: It seems this goddess's shrine is just in the way. We'll protect it no matter what.
m950001.この数の魔物を倒すなんて\n案外やるもんだ。\n英雄の子孫ってのもまんざらじゃな: Defeating this many monsters is surprisingly doable. Being a descendant of heroes isn't so bad after all.
m950001.どうやら私の手には負えないみたいだね。\nならば、あのお方に直接戦ってもらおうか: Looks like I can't handle this myself. Then I'll have that one fight directly… Come on, chase them!
m950001.ふふふ、しつこい奴らだね。\nもしかして私が欲しいのかい……\n私に勝てたら考え: Heh heh, you're persistent, aren't you? Could it be you want me… If you can beat me, I'll think about it.
m950001.森に住む者たちがこの周囲で\n逃げていく魔女を見たという話ですが…\nあの小屋が: The forest dwellers say they saw a witch fleeing around here… Could that cabin be her hideout?
m950001.気を付けてください。\nこの神殿を覆っている霧は\n癒しの力を妨げています。: Please be careful. The mist covering this shrine is hindering healing power.
